```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = FALSE)

library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(DESeq2)
library(apeglm)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
clusterProfiler::bitr(
  c("A1BG", "A2M"),

  OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db
)



base_dir <- "." # Repository root; render from this directory
counts.raw <- read.delim(file.path(base_dir, "counts.txt"), check.names = FALSE)
metadata.full <- read.delim(file.path(base_dir, "metadata.full.txt"), check.names = FALSE)
props.raw <- read.delim(file.path(base_dir, "proporcion_pbmc_proportions.txt"), check.names = FALSE)
rm(list = intersect(c("counts", "metadata", "props"), ls()))

stopifnot("gene_name" %in% colnames(counts.raw))
stopifnot("sample" %in% colnames(metadata.full))
stopifnot("sample" %in% colnames(props.raw))
```


## Reproducibility and scope

This R Markdown documents the ViralAugur transcriptomic analyses, including PBMC discovery analyses, predictive modeling, cross-cohort evaluation, and time-to-seroconversion analyses. The original analytical code has been retained in this annotated version.

**Execution note:** Run the document from the repository root with the required input files present. Several downstream sections also depend on intermediate outputs, external-validation files, or previously constructed objects. The workflow has not yet been validated as a clean-session, end-to-end render. Refer to `ViralAugur_AUDIT.md` for identified dependencies and issues requiring review.

**Statistical note:** Out-of-fold estimates, apparent performance, and independent external validation represent distinct evaluation settings. The deliberate-leakage experiment is a methodological control, not an unbiased estimate of predictive performance.

## Basic input QC (structure and concordance)


```{r qc-inputs}
############################################################
# Basic input QC (structure and consistency)
############################################################

# Counts
head(counts.raw[, 1:6])
dim(counts.raw)

# Metadata
head(metadata.full)
colnames(metadata.full)

# Cells proportions
head(props.raw)
colnames(props.raw)

# Sample consistency (counts vs metadata)
all(colnames(counts.raw)[-1] %in% metadata.full$sample)
all(metadata.full$sample %in% colnames(counts.raw)[-1])

```

### Counts preparation

```{r prepare-counts}
# -------------------------
# 1) COUNTS
# -------------------------
counts_df <- counts.raw
stopifnot("gene_name" %in% colnames(counts_df))

if (any(duplicated(counts_df$gene_name))) {
  message(
    sum(duplicated(counts_df$gene_name)),
    " genes duplicados detectados: agregando por suma."
  )

  counts_df <- counts_df |>
    dplyr::group_by(gene_name) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      dplyr::across(dplyr::where(is.numeric), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

gene_ids  <- counts_df$gene_name
count_mat <- counts_df |>
  dplyr::select(-gene_name) |>
  as.matrix()

mode(count_mat) <- "integer"
rownames(count_mat) <- gene_ids

stopifnot(!any(duplicated(rownames(count_mat))))
stopifnot(!is.null(colnames(count_mat)))

dim(count_mat)
```

### Metadata preparation

```{r prepare-metadata, cache=FALSE}
# -------------------------
# 2) METADATA
# -------------------------
meta_df <- metadata.full
colnames(meta_df) <- make.names(colnames(meta_df))

if (!"sample" %in% colnames(meta_df))
  stop("metadata debe contener una columna 'sample'")

if (!"Condition" %in% colnames(meta_df)) {
  if ("condition" %in% colnames(meta_df)) {
    colnames(meta_df)[colnames(meta_df) == "condition"] <- "Condition"
  } else {
    stop("metadata debe contener una columna 'Condition'")
  }
}

meta_df$Condition <- as.factor(meta_df$Condition)

# -------------------------
# 3) PROPORTIONS
# -------------------------
props_df_raw <- props.raw
colnames(props_df_raw)[1] <- "sample"

# -------------------------
# 4) Sample intersection and ordering
# -------------------------
samples_counts <- colnames(count_mat)
samples_meta   <- meta_df$sample
samples_props  <- props_df_raw$sample

common_samples <- Reduce(intersect,
                          list(samples_counts, samples_meta, samples_props))

if (length(common_samples) < 3)
  stop("Muy pocas muestras en común.")

# Reorder counts and metadata
count_mat <- count_mat[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]

meta_df <- meta_df |>
  dplyr::filter(sample %in% common_samples) |>
  dplyr::arrange(factor(sample, levels = common_samples))

# Sanity check final
stopifnot(identical(meta_df$sample, colnames(count_mat)))

# Standardize primary variable name
if ("Condition" %in% colnames(meta_df)) {
  meta_df$condition <- meta_df$Condition
  meta_df$Condition <- NULL
}

meta_df$condition <- as.factor(meta_df$condition)
```

### Cell´s proportions (Deconvolution)

```{r prepare-cell-proportions, cache=FALSE}
# -------------------------
# 5.0 Selección del método de deconvolución
# -------------------------
nnls_cols <- grep("^nnls_", colnames(props_df_raw), value = TRUE)

if (length(nnls_cols) == 0) {
  stop("No NNLS columns found in cell proportions.")
}

props_df_raw <- props_df_raw |>
  dplyr::select(sample, all_of(nnls_cols))

message("Using cell proportions estimated by NNLS (Granulator).")
# -------------------------
# 5) Prepare proportions (robust method)
# -------------------------
props_only <- props_df_raw |>
  filter(sample %in% common_samples) |>
  arrange(factor(sample, levels = common_samples)) |>
  dplyr::select(-sample)
rownames(props_only) <- common_samples

# 5.1 0–100 -> 0–1 if adequate
if (any(as.matrix(props_only) > 1, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  message("Detected proportions in 0–100 range; converting to 0–1")
  props_only <- props_only / 100
}
# 5.2 Delete negative
props_only[props_only < 0] <- 0
# 5.3 Median imputation for NAs
if (anyNA(props_only)) {
  which_na <- which(is.na(props_only), arr.ind = TRUE)
  muestras_con_na <- unique(rownames(props_only)[which_na[,1]])
  message("NAs found in proportions. Imputing column-wise medians for samples:",
          paste(muestras_con_na, collapse = ", "))
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(props_only))) {
    med_j <- median(props_only[[j]], na.rm = TRUE)
    props_only[[j]][is.na(props_only[[j]])] <- med_j
  }
}
# 5.4 If they sum to ≈1 in ≥80% of samples (±5%), drop 1 column to avoid compositional collinearity.
row_sums <- rowSums(props_only, na.rm = TRUE)
close_to_one <- mean(abs(row_sums - 1) <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) > 0.8
if (close_to_one) {
  message("Proportions sum to ~1: dropping one column to avoid collinearity.")
  props_use <- props_only[, -ncol(props_only), drop = FALSE]
} else {
  message("Proportions do NOT sum to ~1: retaining all columns.")
  props_use <- props_only
}
# 5.5 Eliminate varianze ~0
sds <- apply(props_use, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
zero_var_cols <- names(which(is.na(sds) | sds < 1e-8))
if (length(zero_var_cols) > 0) {
  message("Dropping covariates with near-zero variance ~0: ",
          paste(zero_var_cols, collapse = ", "))
  props_use <- props_use[, setdiff(colnames(props_use), zero_var_cols), drop = FALSE]
}
# 5.6 Drop duplicate (identical) columns
dup_mask <- duplicated(as.list(props_use))
if (any(dup_mask)) {
  dup_names <- colnames(props_use)[dup_mask]
  message("Removing duplicate covariates: ", paste(dup_names, collapse = ", "))
  props_use <- props_use[, !dup_mask, drop = FALSE]
}
# 5.7 Centrado/escalado
props_scaled <- scale(props_use, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE) |> as.data.frame()
colnames(props_scaled) <- make.names(colnames(props_scaled))

stopifnot(all(rownames(props_scaled) == colnames(count_mat)))


# Cell proportions were automatically preprocessed to ensure their suitability as model covariates. Percent-scale estimates were transformed to a 0–1 range, near-zero variance covariates were filtered out, and duplicate profiles were removed. Since the proportions did not strictly adhere to compositional closure, all remaining covariates were retained, followed by centering and scaling.



# -------------------------
# 6) colData and validation checks
# -------------------------
col_data <- bind_cols(meta_df, props_scaled) |> as.data.frame()
rownames(col_data) <- col_data$sample

# Standardize the name of the main variable
if ("Condition" %in% colnames(col_data) && !"condition" %in% colnames(col_data)) {
  col_data$condition <- col_data$Condition
}
col_data$condition <- as.factor(col_data$condition)

# Check for duplicate sample and gene identifiers
if (anyDuplicated(rownames(col_data)) > 0) {
  stop("Duplicate sample identifiers found in col_data: ",
       paste(unique(rownames(col_data)[duplicated(rownames(col_data))]), collapse = ", "))
}
if (anyDuplicated(rownames(count_mat)) > 0) {
  stop("Duplicate genes remain after aggregation. Check 'counts'.")
}

# Check alignment between counts and metadata
stopifnot(identical(rownames(col_data), colnames(count_mat)))

# Ensure condition has at least two levels
if (nlevels(col_data$condition) < 2) {
  stop("condition has only one level among the shared samples; the model cannot be fitted.")
}


```



### Cell proportion selection

```{r select-nnls-parsimonious, cache=FALSE}

# ============================================================
# Parsimonious selection of cell proportions (NNLS)
# ============================================================

# Compute PCA using all available scaled cell proportions
pca_cell <- prcomp(props_scaled, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

# Extract PC1 loadings
loadings_pc1 <- pca_cell$rotation[, 1]

# Rank by absolute contribution to PC1
loadings_sorted <- sort(abs(loadings_pc1), decreasing = TRUE)

# Select the top five cell proportions
top_n <- 5
selected_nnls <- names(loadings_sorted)[seq_len(top_n)]

message("Selected NNLS cell proportions (PC1): ",
        paste(selected_nnls, collapse = ", "))

# Retain the selected cell proportions
props_scaled <- props_scaled[, selected_nnls, drop = FALSE]

```



```{r}
library(glmnet)

# Predictor matrix: ALL cell proportions
X <- as.matrix(props_scaled)

# Response variable
y <- col_data$condition
y <- factor(y, levels = c("HIV", "HESN"))
y_bin <- ifelse(y == "HESN", 1, 0)

stopifnot(nrow(X) == length(y_bin))

set.seed(123)

cvfit <- cv.glmnet(
  x = X,
  y = y_bin,
  family = "binomial",
  alpha = 0.5,        # Elastic Net
  nfolds = 5,
  type.measure = "auc"
)

# Cross-validated AUC
auc_cv <- max(cvfit$cvm)
auc_cv

model_final <- glmnet(
  x = X,
  y = y_bin,
  family = "binomial",
  alpha = 0.5,
  lambda = cvfit$lambda.min
)

coef_mat <- coef(model_final)

coef_df <- data.frame(
  cell_type = rownames(coef_mat),
  beta      = as.numeric(coef_mat)
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(beta != 0, cell_type != "(Intercept)") %>%
  arrange(desc(beta))

coef_df

write.table(
  coef_df,
  file = file.path(base_dir, "Cellular_model_ALLtypes_coefficients.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

### Logistic regression Cell proportions

```{r LOGISTIC_PROP_CELLULAR}
# 0) Ensure the binary response variable exists in the dataframe
col_data$condition_bin <- ifelse(col_data$condition == "HESN", 1, 0)

# 1) PCA on cell proportions
cell_pca <- prcomp(props_scaled, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
cell_pcs <- as.data.frame(cell_pca$x[, 1:3])
colnames(cell_pcs) <- c("cell_PC1", "cell_PC2", "cell_PC3")

# 2) Merge and standardize
# Match rows by sample identifiers to ensure correct alignment
col_data <- cbind(col_data, cell_pcs[rownames(col_data), ])

col_data$cell_PC1_z <- scale(col_data$cell_PC1)
col_data$cell_PC2_z <- scale(col_data$cell_PC2)
col_data$cell_PC3_z <- scale(col_data$cell_PC3)

# 3) Logistic regression models
m1 <- glm(condition_bin ~ cell_PC1_z, family = binomial, data = col_data)
m2 <- glm(condition_bin ~ cell_PC1_z + cell_PC2_z, family = binomial, data = col_data)
m3 <- glm(condition_bin ~ cell_PC1_z + cell_PC3_z, family = binomial, data = col_data)

# Model comparison
anova(m1, m2, m3, test = "Chisq")

# Null model versus PC-based model
m0  <- glm(condition_bin ~ 1, family = binomial, data = col_data)
m12 <- glm(condition_bin ~ cell_PC1_z + cell_PC3_z, family = binomial, data = col_data)

anova(m0, m12, test = "Chisq")
summary(m12)
```



```{r}
# Final model
fit_cell <- glm(
  condition_bin ~ cell_PC1_z + cell_PC3_z,
  family = binomial,
  data = col_data
)

# Odds ratios and profile-likelihood 95% confidence intervals
or_tab <- exp(
  cbind(
    OR  = coef(fit_cell),
    confint(fit_cell)
  )
)

or_tab

or_df <- data.frame(
  term  = rownames(or_tab),
  OR    = or_tab[, "OR"],
  CI_low  = or_tab[, 2],
  CI_high = or_tab[, 3]
) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)")

or_df

write.table(
  or_df,
  file = file.path(base_dir, "Logistic_model_cellPC_ORs.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

### DESeq2 – FINAL MODEL (batch + cell_PC1)

```{r DESEQ_CON_PC1+PC3}
############################################################
# DESeq2 – FINAL MODEL (batch + cell_PC1)
############################################################

library(DESeq2)
library(edgeR)
library(ggplot2)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 1) Prepare covariates
## ---------------------------------------------------------

# Factors
col_data$batch     <- factor(col_data$batch)
col_data$condition <- factor(col_data$condition, levels = c("HIV", "HESN"))

# Standardize cell PCs
col_data$cell_PC1_z <- scale(col_data$cell_PC1)

# Defensive validation
stopifnot(
  all(c("batch", "condition", "cell_PC1_z") %in% colnames(col_data))
)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 2) Model design
## ---------------------------------------------------------

design_formula <- ~ batch + cell_PC1_z + condition
message("Design formula: ", deparse(design_formula))

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_mat,
  colData   = col_data,
  design    = design_formula
)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 3) CPM filtering (technical)
## ---------------------------------------------------------

keep <- rowSums(cpm(counts(dds)) >= 1) >= 5
dds  <- dds[keep, ]

message("Genes retained after CPM filtering: ", sum(keep))

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 4) Run DESeq2
## ---------------------------------------------------------

dds <- DESeq(dds)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 5) Results: condition (HESN vs HIV)
## ---------------------------------------------------------

coef_name <- grep("^condition_", resultsNames(dds), value = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(coef_name) == 1)

res_cond <- lfcShrink(
  dds,
  coef = coef_name,
  type = "apeglm"
)

res_cond_df <- as.data.frame(res_cond[order(res_cond$padj), ])

write.table(
  cbind(gene = rownames(res_cond_df), res_cond_df),
  file = file.path(base_dir, "DESeq2_results_condition_PC1.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

message("DESeq2 results saved.")



# ============================================================
# 6) Final QC — display and save figures
# ============================================================

# Reuse the existing VST object when available
if (!exists("vsd")) vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)

# Prepare PCA
pca <- DESeq2::plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "condition", returnData = TRUE)
percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pca, "percentVar"))

p_pca <- ggplot(pca, aes(PC1, PC2, color = condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "%")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "%")) +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("PCA (VST-transformed expression)")

# Display both figures in RStudio
DESeq2::plotMA(res_cond, main = "MA plot - condition", ylim = c(-5, 5))
print(p_pca)

# Save both figures in a single PDF
pdf(file.path(base_dir, "DESeq2_QC.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)
DESeq2::plotMA(res_cond, main = "MA plot - condition", ylim = c(-5, 5))
print(p_pca)
dev.off()

message("QC figures displayed and saved.")

# Display the top 20 differentially expressed genes
print(head(res_cond_df, 20))

# Summarize differential expression
cat("Genes tested:", nrow(res_cond_df), "\n")
cat("Genes with adjusted p < 0.05:", sum(res_cond_df$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")


```

###  DESeq2 – FINAL MODEL WITHOUT CELL PROPORTION ADJUSTMENT


```{r DESeq2-noCell, cache=FALSE}
############################################################
# DESeq2 — FINAL MODEL WITHOUT CELL COMPOSITION ADJUSTMENT
############################################################

library(DESeq2)
library(edgeR)
library(ggplot2)

# ============================================================
# 1) Prepare covariates
# ============================================================

col_data$batch <- factor(col_data$batch)
col_data$condition <- factor(col_data$condition, levels = c("HIV", "HESN"))

stopifnot(all(c("batch", "condition") %in% colnames(col_data)))

# ============================================================
# 2) Model design
# ============================================================

design_formula <- ~ batch + condition
message("Final design formula: ", deparse(design_formula))

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = count_mat, colData = col_data, design = design_formula)

# ============================================================
# 3) CPM filtering
# ============================================================

keep <- rowSums(edgeR::cpm(counts(dds)) >= 1) >= 5
dds <- dds[keep, ]

message("Genes retained after CPM filtering: ", sum(keep))

# ============================================================
# 4) Run DESeq2
# ============================================================

dds <- DESeq(dds)

# ============================================================
# 5) Differential expression: HESN vs HIV
# ============================================================

coef_name <- grep("^condition_", resultsNames(dds), value = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(coef_name) == 1)

res_cond <- lfcShrink(dds, coef = coef_name, type = "apeglm")
res_cond_df <- as.data.frame(res_cond[order(res_cond$padj), ])

# Display the top 20 genes
cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("TOP 20 DIFFERENTIALLY EXPRESSED GENES\n")
cat("============================================\n")

print(head(data.frame(gene = rownames(res_cond_df), res_cond_df), 20))

# Format results for export
res_out <- res_cond_df
round_cols <- c("baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "lfcSE")
res_out[round_cols] <- lapply(res_out[round_cols], round, 3)
res_out$pvalue <- formatC(as.numeric(res_out$pvalue), format = "e", digits = 3)
res_out$padj <- formatC(as.numeric(res_out$padj), format = "e", digits = 3)

write.table(
  cbind(gene = rownames(res_out), res_out),
  file = file.path(base_dir, "DESeq2_results_condition_noCell.tsv"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)

message("DESeq2 results (without cell composition adjustment) saved.")

# ============================================================
# 6) Significant differentially expressed genes
# ============================================================

sig_bio <- res_cond_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05, abs(log2FoldChange) > 0.25)

cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION SUMMARY\n")
cat("============================================\n")

cat("Genes tested:", nrow(res_cond_df), "\n")
cat("Genes with FDR < 0.05:", sum(res_cond_df$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Genes with FDR < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 0.25:", nrow(sig_bio), "\n")

# Display significant genes
print(head(data.frame(gene = rownames(sig_bio), sig_bio), 20))

write.table(
  cbind(gene = rownames(sig_bio), sig_bio),
  file = file.path(base_dir, "DESeq2_sig_biological_nocell.tsv"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)

message("Significant DE genes (biological threshold): ", nrow(sig_bio))

# ============================================================
# 7) Quality control — display and save
# ============================================================

vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)

# Prepare PCA
pca <- DESeq2::plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "condition", returnData = TRUE)
percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pca, "percentVar"))

p_pca <- ggplot(pca, aes(PC1, PC2, color = condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "%")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "%")) +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("PCA (VST, without cell composition adjustment)")

# Display MA plot in RStudio
DESeq2::plotMA(res_cond, main = "MA plot - condition (no cell adjustment)", ylim = c(-5, 5))

# Display PCA in RStudio
print(p_pca)

# Save both plots in a single PDF
pdf(file.path(base_dir, "DESeq2_QC_noCell.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)
DESeq2::plotMA(res_cond, main = "MA plot - condition (no cell adjustment)", ylim = c(-5, 5))
print(p_pca)
dev.off()

message("QC figures displayed and saved.")

# ============================================================
# 8) Save model and VST expression matrix
# ============================================================

saveRDS(dds, file = file.path(base_dir, "dds_final_noCell.rds"))

write.table(
  assay(vsd),
  file = file.path(base_dir, "VST_expression_matrix_noCell.tsv"),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE
)

message("DESeq2 model without cell composition adjustment completed.")
```



```{r}
############################################################
# Extract HESN-upregulated and HIV-upregulated genes
# (model without cell composition adjustment)
############################################################

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

alpha <- 0.05
lfc_cutoff <- 0   # Set to 1 for a more stringent threshold

# 1) Add gene identifier column
res_tbl <- res_cond_df %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene")

# 2) Identify significant genes
sig_res <- res_tbl %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj), padj < alpha)

message("Total significant genes: ", nrow(sig_res))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) HESN-upregulated genes (log2FC > 0)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
hesn_up <- sig_res %>%
  filter(log2FoldChange > lfc_cutoff)

message("HESN-upregulated genes: ", nrow(hesn_up))

write.table(
  hesn_up,
  file = file.path(base_dir, "DESeq2_HESN_up_noCell.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) HIV-upregulated genes (log2FC < 0)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
hiv_up <- sig_res %>%
  filter(log2FoldChange < -lfc_cutoff)

message("HIV-upregulated genes: ", nrow(hiv_up))

write.table(
  hiv_up,
  file = file.path(base_dir, "DESeq2_HIV_up_noCell.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
  # Generate enrichment plot
  p <- plotEnrichment(pathways_go[[p_name]], ranks_vec) +

    width = 8, 
    height = 6, 
    dpi = 300
```

```{r}
  dplyr::select(pathway, Enriched_In, NES, padj, genes)
```

# HIGH-QUALITY GSEA PLOTS

```{r}
library(fgsea)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(stringr)

# 1. Manual selection of specific pathways
# Exact pathway identifiers are used to ensure correct NES matching
pathways_HESN <- c(
  "GOBP_SENSORY_PERCEPTION_OF_CHEMICAL_STIMULUS",
  "GOBP_HOMOPHILIC_CELL_CELL_ADHESION", 
  "GOBP_G_PROTEIN_COUPLED_RECEPTOR_SIGNALING_PATHWAY_COUPLED_TO_CYCLIC_NUCLEOTIDE_SECOND_MESSENGER", 
  "GOBP_XENOBIOTIC_METABOLIC_PROCESS", 
  "GOBP_REGULATION_OF_NUCLEOTIDE_BIOSYNTHETIC_PROCESS", 
  "GOBP_INOSITOL_PHOSPHATE_METABOLIC_PROCESS"
 )

pathways_HIV <- c(
  "GOBP_REGULATION_OF_MRNA_PROCESSING", 
  "GOBP_DNA_INTEGRITY_CHECKPOINT_SIGNALING", 
  "GOBP_ANDROGEN_RECEPTOR_SIGNALING_PATHWAY", 
 "GOBP_ANTIGEN_PROCESSING_AND_PRESENTATION_OF_PEPTIDE_ANTIGEN_VIA_MHC_CLASS_I", 
  "GOBP_POSITIVE_REGULATION_OF_INTERFERON_BETA_PRODUCTION", 
  "GOBP_CELL_CYCLE_CHECKPOINT_SIGNALING"
)

selected_pathways <- c(pathways_HESN, pathways_HIV)

# 2. Publication-quality plotting function
make_custom_gsea_plot <- function(p_name, ranks, pathways_list, fgsea_results) {
  # Extract the results row for the selected pathway
  res_row <- fgsea_results[fgsea_results$pathway == p_name, ]
  
  # Remove additional GSEA_ and GOBP_ prefixes, if present
  clean_title <- gsub("GSEA_", "", p_name)
  clean_title <- gsub("GOBP_", "", clean_title)
  clean_title <- str_to_sentence(gsub("_", " ", clean_title))
  
  # Color based on NES direction
  line_color <- if(nrow(res_row) > 0 && res_row$NES > 0) "#B2182B" else "#2166AC"
  
  # Statistics displayed in the subtitle
  p_stats <- if(nrow(res_row) > 0) {
    paste0("NES: ", round(res_row$NES, 2), " | p-adj: ", format.pval(res_row$padj, digits = 2))
  } else { "Data not found" }

  p <- plotEnrichment(pathways_list[[p_name]], ranks)
  p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$colour <- line_color
  p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$size <- 1.1
  
  p + labs(title = str_wrap(clean_title, 35), subtitle = p_stats, x = NULL, y = "ES") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8, lineheight = 0.9),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, color = "grey30"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

# 3. Generate enrichment plots
list_plots <- lapply(selected_pathways, function(p) {
  make_custom_gsea_plot(p, ranks_vec, pathways_go, fgsea_res)
})

# 4. Arrange plots into a multi-panel figure (2 columns, approximately 6 rows)
final_grid <- plot_grid(
  plotlist = list_plots, 
  ncol = 2, 
  labels = "AUTO", 
  label_size = 10,
  align = "hv"
)

# 5. Save high-resolution figures
ggsave("GSEA_Final_Custom_Selection.pdf", final_grid, width = 9, height = 15)
ggsave("GSEA_Final_Custom_Selection.png", final_grid, width = 9, height = 15, dpi = 300)

# 1. Define colors for interpretation: blue (HESN/protection) vs red (HIV/risk)
color_HESN <- "#2166AC" # Blue
color_HIV  <- "#B2182B" # Red

# 2. Plotting function with reversed color scheme
make_custom_gsea_plot <- function(p_name, ranks, pathways_list, fgsea_results) {
  res_row <- fgsea_results[fgsea_results$pathway == p_name, ]
  
  # Remove pathway name prefixes
  clean_title <- gsub("GSEA_|GOBP_", "", p_name)
  clean_title <- str_to_sentence(gsub("_", " ", clean_title))
  
  # REVERSED COLOR SCHEME:
  # NES > 0 (HESN) -> Blue (protection)
  # NES < 0 (HIV)  -> Red (risk)
  line_color <- if(nrow(res_row) > 0 && res_row$NES > 0) color_HESN else color_HIV
  
  p_stats <- if(nrow(res_row) > 0) {
    paste0("NES: ", round(res_row$NES, 2), " | p-adj: ", format.pval(res_row$padj, digits = 2))
  } else { "Data not found" }

  p <- plotEnrichment(pathways_list[[p_name]], ranks)
  p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$colour <- line_color
  p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$size <- 1.2
  
  p + labs(title = str_wrap(clean_title, 35), subtitle = p_stats, x = NULL, y = "ES") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, color = "grey30"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

# 3. Generate and combine all 12 panels
list_plots <- lapply(selected_pathways, function(p) {
  make_custom_gsea_plot(p, ranks_vec, pathways_go, fgsea_res)
})

# Adjust PDF height to accommodate all 12 plots
final_grid <- plot_grid(
  plotlist = list_plots, 
  ncol = 2, 
  labels = "AUTO", 
  label_size = 10,
  align = "hv"
)

# 4. Save final figures
ggsave("GSEA_Final_InvertedColors.pdf", final_grid, width = 10, height = 16)
ggsave("GSEA_Final_InvertedColors.png", final_grid,width = 10, height = 16, dpi = 300)
message("Figure generated: blue for HESN (protection) and red for HIV (risk)")
```

# Volcano plot 

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)

alpha <- 0.05
lfc_cutoff <- 0.25   # Use 0.5 for greater stringency or 0 to include more genes

volcano_df <- res_cond_df %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
  mutate(
    negLog10Padj = -log10(padj),
    regulation = case_when(
      padj < alpha & log2FoldChange >=  lfc_cutoff  ~ "HESN-up",
      padj < alpha & log2FoldChange <= -lfc_cutoff  ~ "HIV-up",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )

library(ggrepel)

top_genes <- volcano_df %>%
  filter(regulation != "Not significant") %>%
  arrange(padj) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

ggplot(volcano_df,
       aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = negLog10Padj, color = regulation)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = top_genes,
    aes(label = gene),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = 20
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "HESN-up" = "#2166AC",
      "HIV-up"  = "#B2182B",#B2182B
      "Not significant or -log10FC<0.25" = "grey70"
    )
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cutoff, lfc_cutoff),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(alpha),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano plot – HESN vs HIV",
    x = "log2 Fold Change",
    y = "-log10 FDR"
  )

# 1. Assign the plot to an object (e.g., p_volcano)
p_volcano <- ggplot(volcano_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = negLog10Padj, color = regulation)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = top_genes,
    aes(label = gene),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = 20
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "HESN-up" = "#2166AC",
      "HIV-up"  = "#B2182B",
      "Not significant" = "grey70" # Matches the categories defined in mutate()
    )
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cutoff, lfc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(alpha), linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano plot – HESN vs HIV",
    x = "log2 Fold Change",
    y = "-log10 FDR"
  )

# --- OPTION A: Vector formats (RECOMMENDED for journals / Illustrator / Inkscape) ---
# Resolution-independent graphics that remain sharp at any zoom level
ggsave("Volcano_plot_HESN_vs_HIV.pdf", plot = p_volcano, width = 7, height = 6, units = "in")
ggsave("Volcano_plot_HESN_vs_HIV.svg", plot = p_volcano, width = 7, height = 6, units = "in")

# --- OPTION B: High-resolution raster formats (PNG / TIFF at 300 DPI) ---
ggsave("Volcano_plot_HESN_vs_HIV.png", plot = p_volcano, width = 7, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 300)
ggsave("Volcano_plot_HESN_vs_HIV.tiff", plot = p_volcano, width = 7, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 300, compression = "lzw")
```

# Heatmap HIV seroconverters vs. HESN

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(pheatmap)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 1) DESeq2 results with biological filtering
## ---------------------------------------------------------

res_df <- res_cond_df %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj))

sig_bio <- res_df %>%
  filter(
    padj < 0.05,
    abs(log2FoldChange) > 0.5
  )

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 2) Selection of top differentially expressed genes
## ---------------------------------------------------------

n_top <- 50   # Can be adjusted to 30 or 100

genes_hesn_up <- sig_bio %>%
  filter(log2FoldChange > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(log2FoldChange)) %>%
  slice_head(n = n_top) %>%
  pull(gene)

genes_hiv_up <- sig_bio %>%
  filter(log2FoldChange < 0) %>%
  arrange(log2FoldChange) %>%
  slice_head(n = n_top) %>%
  pull(gene)

message("HESN-upregulated genes selected for heatmap: ", length(genes_hesn_up))
message("HIV-upregulated genes selected for heatmap: ", length(genes_hiv_up))

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 3) VST expression matrix and row scaling
## ---------------------------------------------------------

vst_mat <- assay(vsd)

scale_rows <- function(x) {
  t(scale(t(x)))
}

sample_order <- rownames(col_data)

mat_hesn <- scale_rows(vst_mat[genes_hesn_up, sample_order, drop = FALSE])
mat_hiv  <- scale_rows(vst_mat[genes_hiv_up,  sample_order, drop = FALSE])

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 4) Sample annotations
## ---------------------------------------------------------

annotation_col <- data.frame(
  Condition = factor(
    col_data$condition,
    levels = c("HIV", "HESN")
  )
)
rownames(annotation_col) <- rownames(col_data)

ann_colors <- list(
  Condition = c(
    HIV  = "#2166AC",
    HESN = "#B2182B"
  )
)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 5) Heatmap of HESN-upregulated genes
## ---------------------------------------------------------

if (nrow(mat_hesn) >= 2) {
  pheatmap(
    mat_hesn,
    annotation_col = annotation_col,
    annotation_colors = ann_colors,
    show_colnames = FALSE,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    fontsize_row = 7,
    annotation_names_col = FALSE,
    annotation_legend = TRUE,
    main = "Genes upregulated in HESN (vs HIV)"
  )
} else {
  message("Insufficient HESN-upregulated genes for heatmap (n < 2).")
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 6) Heatmap of HIV-upregulated genes
## ---------------------------------------------------------

if (nrow(mat_hiv) >= 2) {
  pheatmap(
    mat_hiv,
    annotation_col = annotation_col,
    annotation_colors = ann_colors,
    show_colnames = FALSE,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    fontsize_row = 7,
    annotation_names_col = FALSE,
    annotation_legend = TRUE,
    main = "Genes upregulated in HIV (vs HESN)"
  )
} else {
  message("Insufficient HIV-upregulated genes for heatmap (n < 2).")
}
```

```{r}
  )
)
rownames(annotation_col) <- sample_names

ann_colors <- list(
  Condition = c(
    HIV  = "#2166AC",
    HESN = "#B2182B"
  )
)

## Gene-level annotation (direction of differential expression)
annotation_row <- data.frame(
  Regulation = ifelse(
    genes_all %in% genes_hesn_up,
    "HESN-up",
    "HIV-up"
  )
)
rownames(annotation_row) <- genes_all

ann_row_colors <- list(
  Regulation = c(
    "HESN-up" = "#B2182B",
    "HIV-up"  = "#2166AC"
  )
)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 5) Combined heatmap
## ---------------------------------------------------------

if (nrow(mat_all) >= 2) {
  pheatmap(
    mat_all,
    annotation_col = annotation_col,
    annotation_row = annotation_row,
    annotation_colors = c(ann_colors, ann_row_colors),
    show_colnames = FALSE,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    fontsize_row = 6,
    annotation_names_col = FALSE,
    annotation_names_row = FALSE,
    main = "Differentially expressed genes (HESN vs HIV)"
  )
} else {
  message("Insufficient genes to generate the combined heatmap.")
}
```

```{r}
  Regulation = c(
    "HESN-up" = "#B2182B",
    "HIV-up"  = "#2166AC"
  )
)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 5) Combined heatmap
## ---------------------------------------------------------

if (nrow(mat_all) >= 2) {
  pheatmap(
    mat_all,
    annotation_col = annotation_col,
    annotation_row = annotation_row,

  )
} else {
```

## PREDICTIVE MODEL – Baseline RNA-seq (PBMC – GENES ONLY)

```{r}
############################################################
## PREDICTIVE MODEL – Baseline RNA-seq (PBMC – GENES ONLY)
## Outcome: condition (HESN vs HIV)
## Method: Logistic Elastic Net + leakage-free cross-validation and beta coefficient tracking
############################################################

library(glmnet)
library(pROC)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(DESeq2)
library(edgeR)
library(caret)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 1) Retrieve and align the original raw count matrix
## ---------------------------------------------------------
if (exists("dds")) {
  mat_raw <- counts(dds)
} else {
  stop("ERROR: The 'dds' object containing raw counts is required. Do not use assay(vsd) to reconstruct counts.")
}

# Strict global sample alignment check
stopifnot(identical(colnames(mat_raw), rownames(col_data)))

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 2) Response variable (atomic vectors)
## ---------------------------------------------------------
y <- col_data$condition
y <- factor(y, levels = c("HIV", "HESN"))   # HIV as reference
y_bin <- unname(ifelse(y == "HESN", 1, 0))

print("Response variable distribution:")
print(table(y))

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 3) Initialize cross-validation folds and coefficient history
## ---------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(123)
folds <- caret::createFolds(y, k = 5, list = TRUE)

all_preds_min <- rep(NA_real_, length(y_bin))
all_preds_1se <- rep(NA_real_, length(y_bin))
used_planB    <- rep(FALSE, length(folds))

# Master data frame retaining the 'Gene' column for downstream plotting scripts
coefficients_history <- data.frame(
  Fold = character(),
  Gene = character(), # Retained as Gene
  Beta = numeric(),
  Lambda = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Master data frame tracking genes passing the DESeq2 filter in each fold
deseq_passage_history <- data.frame(
  Fold = character(),
  Gene = character(),
  Passed_DESeq = logical(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 4) Leakage-free cross-validation loop
## ---------------------------------------------------------
for (i in seq_along(folds)) {

  message("--- Fold ", i, " of 5 ---")

  test_idx  <- folds[[i]]
  train_idx <- setdiff(seq_along(y_bin), test_idx)

  # Split raw counts into training and test sets
  X_raw_tr <- mat_raw[, train_idx, drop = FALSE]
  X_raw_te <- mat_raw[, test_idx, drop = FALSE]

  meta_tr <- col_data[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  meta_te <- col_data[test_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  
  Y_tr_ml <- y_bin[train_idx]

  ## Run DESeq2 ONLY on the training subset of each fold
  dds_tr <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = round(X_raw_tr),
    colData = meta_tr,
    design = ~ condition
  )
  
  # Filter lowly expressed genes to improve model stability
  keep <- rowSums(counts(dds_tr) >= 10) >= 5
  dds_tr <- dds_tr[keep, ]
  
  dds_tr <- DESeq(dds_tr, quiet = TRUE)
  res_tr <- results(dds_tr, contrast = c("condition", "HESN", "HIV"))

  # Within-fold biological filtering
  res_tr_df <- as.data.frame(res_tr) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    filter(!is.na(padj))

  # [CRITICAL INTERNAL ADJUSTMENT] Threshold set to 0.5 for consistency with the combined model
  sig_bio_fold <- res_tr_df %>%
    filter(padj < 0.05, abs(log2FoldChange) > 0.5)

  genes_ml_fold <- sig_bio_fold$gene

  # Optimized fallback strategy: retain the top 100 genes ranked by p-value
  if (length(genes_ml_fold) < 5) {
    used_planB[i] <- TRUE
    genes_ml_fold <- res_tr_df %>%
      filter(!is.na(pvalue)) %>%
      arrange(pvalue) %>%
      slice_head(n = 100) %>%
      pull(gene)
  }

  # Corrected gene matching and ordering
  genes_ml_fold <- genes_ml_fold[genes_ml_fold %in% rownames(X_raw_te)]

  # [NEW TRACEABILITY VARIABLE] Record genes passing the within-fold selection filter
  df_deseq_fold <- data.frame(
    Fold = paste0("Fold_", i),
    Gene = genes_ml_fold,
    Passed_DESeq = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  deseq_passage_history <- rbind(deseq_passage_history, df_deseq_fold)
  
  if (length(genes_ml_fold) < 2) {
    stop(paste("ERROR: Fold", i, "has fewer than 2 available genes. The pipeline cannot continue."))
  }

  ## Fold-specific TMM normalization
  base_genes <- rownames(dds_tr)

  dge_tr <- DGEList(counts = X_raw_tr[base_genes, , drop = FALSE])
  dge_tr <- calcNormFactors(dge_tr, method = "TMM")
  logCPM_tr <- cpm(dge_tr, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)

  dge_te <- DGEList(counts = X_raw_te[base_genes, , drop = FALSE])
  dge_te <- calcNormFactors(dge_te, method = "TMM")
  logCPM_te <- cpm(dge_te, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)

  # Construct transposed predictive feature matrices
  X_tr_ml <- t(logCPM_tr[genes_ml_fold, , drop = FALSE])
  X_te_ml <- t(logCPM_te[genes_ml_fold, , drop = FALSE])

  # Preserve original gene identifiers before removing row names for glmnet
  gene_names_fold <- colnames(X_tr_ml)

  rownames(X_tr_ml) <- NULL
  rownames(X_te_ml) <- NULL

  # Within-fold data integrity and alignment checks
  stopifnot(nrow(X_tr_ml) == length(Y_tr_ml))
  stopifnot(ncol(X_tr_ml) == ncol(X_te_ml))

  set.seed(1000 + i)

  # [CRITICAL INTERNAL ADJUSTMENT] Use deviance and nfolds = 3 for consistency with the combined model
  cvfit_inner <- cv.glmnet(
    x = as.matrix(X_tr_ml),
    y = Y_tr_ml,
    family = "binomial",
    alpha = 0.5,
    nfolds = 3,
    type.measure = "deviance",
    standardize = TRUE
  )

  # Store predictions for held-out test samples
  all_preds_min[test_idx] <- as.numeric(predict(cvfit_inner, newx = as.matrix(X_te_ml), s = "lambda.min", type = "response"))
  all_preds_1se[test_idx] <- as.numeric(predict(cvfit_inner, newx = as.matrix(X_te_ml), s = "lambda.1se", type = "response"))

  # Extract and store gene-level beta coefficients for both lambda values
  for (lambda_str in c("lambda.min", "lambda.1se")) {
    coef_matrix <- as.matrix(coef(cvfit_inner, s = lambda_str))
    
    df_fold_coefs <- data.frame(
      Fold = paste0("Fold_", i),
      Gene = c("(Intercept)", gene_names_fold), # Retained as Gene
      Beta = as.numeric(coef_matrix[, 1]),
      Lambda = lambda_str,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    coefficients_history <- rbind(coefficients_history, df_fold_coefs)
  }
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 5) Mandatory quality control and overall model evaluation
## ---------------------------------------------------------
ok <- !is.na(all_preds_min)
if (sum(ok) != length(y_bin)) {
  stop("ERROR: The pipeline stopped because at least one sample has no prediction.")
}

roc_min <- roc(response = y_bin, predictor = all_preds_min, levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)
roc_1se <- roc(response = y_bin, predictor = all_preds_1se, levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)

# Determine optimal classification thresholds using Youden's index
thr_min <- as.numeric(pROC::coords(roc_min, x = "best", best.method = "youden", ret = "threshold"))[1]
thr_1se <- as.numeric(pROC::coords(roc_1se, x = "best", best.method = "youden", ret = "threshold"))[1]

auc_real_min <- as.numeric(auc(roc_min))
auc_real_1se <- as.numeric(auc(roc_1se))



## Export OOF predictions for downstream ROC analysis
pred_file <- file.path(base_dir, "Predictive_model_GENES_ONLY_predictions.tsv")

preds_df <- data.frame(
  Sample = colnames(mat_raw),
  y_bin = y_bin,
  pred_lambda_min = all_preds_min,
  pred_lambda_1se = all_preds_1se
)

stopifnot(!anyNA(preds_df))
write.table(preds_df, file = pred_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
message("OOF predictions exported: ", normalizePath(pred_file))



## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 6) CALCULATE ADDITIONAL PERFORMANCE METRICS (using Youden's index)
## ---------------------------------------------------------
preds_min_puras <- unname(as.numeric(all_preds_min))
preds_1se_puras <- unname(as.numeric(all_preds_1se))
y_bin_puro       <- unname(as.numeric(y_bin))

clase_pred_min <- factor(ifelse(preds_min_puras >= thr_min, 1, 0), levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("HIV", "HESN"))
clase_pred_1se <- factor(ifelse(preds_1se_puras >= thr_1se, 1, 0), levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("HIV", "HESN"))
clase_real     <- factor(y_bin_puro, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("HIV", "HESN"))

cm_min <- caret::confusionMatrix(data = clase_pred_min, reference = clase_real, positive = "HESN")
cm_1se <- caret::confusionMatrix(data = clase_pred_1se, reference = clase_real, positive = "HESN")

# Export the final performance metrics summary [MATCHING THE COMBINED MODEL]
df_metrics_youden <- data.frame(
  Modelo = c("lambda.min", "lambda.1se"), 
  AUC_Recalculado = c(auc_real_min, auc_real_1se), 
  Youden_Threshold = c(thr_min, thr_1se),
  Accuracy = c(cm_min$overall["Accuracy"], cm_1se$overall["Accuracy"]), 
  Sensitivity_Recall = c(cm_min$byClass["Sensitivity"], cm_1se$byClass["Sensitivity"]),
  Specificity = c(cm_min$byClass["Specificity"], cm_1se$byClass["Specificity"]), 
  Precision_PPV = c(cm_min$byClass["Pos Pred Value"], cm_1se$byClass["Pos Pred Value"]),
  NPV = c(cm_min$byClass["Neg Pred Value"], cm_1se$byClass["Neg Pred Value"]), 
  F1_Score = c(cm_min$byClass["F1"], cm_1se$byClass["F1"])
)

write.table(df_metrics_youden, file = file.path(base_dir, "Predictive_model_GENES_ONLY_detailed_metrics_Youden.tsv"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
library(dplyr)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## 7) Generate pipeline attrition summary (DESeq2 vs Elastic Net)
## ---------------------------------------------------------

# 1. Count the number of folds in which each gene passed DESeq2 filtering
deseq_counts <- deseq_passage_history %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(Folds_Passed_DESeq = sum(Passed_DESeq), .groups = "drop")

# 2. Count Elastic Net selections (lambda.1se) and summarize conditional beta coefficients
en_counts <- coefficients_history %>%
  filter(Lambda == "lambda.1se", Gene != "(Intercept)") %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(
    Folds_Selected_EN = sum(Beta != 0),
    Mean_Beta_Conditional = mean(Beta[Beta != 0]),
    Median_Beta_Conditional = median(Beta[Beta != 0]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3. Merge selection histories and classify genes by selection stability
pipeline_attrition_summary <- full_join(deseq_counts, en_counts, by = "Gene") %>%
  mutate(
    Folds_Passed_DESeq = coalesce(Folds_Passed_DESeq, 0L),
    Folds_Selected_EN  = coalesce(Folds_Selected_EN, 0L),
    Sign = ifelse(coalesce(Mean_Beta_Conditional, 0) > 0, "Up in HESN", "Up in HIV")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Estatus_Seleccion = case_when(
      # Genes selected by Elastic Net, classified by selection stability
      Folds_Selected_EN == 5 ~ "Definitive Signature (Highly Robust - 100%)",
      Folds_Selected_EN == 4 ~ "Highly Stable Signature (80%)",
      Folds_Selected_EN == 3 ~ "Moderately Stable Signature (60%)",
      Folds_Selected_EN %in% c(1, 2) ~ "Marginal / Unstable Selection (<50%)",
      
      # Genes never selected by Elastic Net (0 folds)
      Folds_Passed_DESeq == 5 & Folds_Selected_EN == 0 ~ "Excluded by Elastic Net (Redundancy/Collinearity)",
      Folds_Passed_DESeq < 5 & Folds_Selected_EN == 0  ~ "DESeq2 Filtering Failure (Insufficient Within-Fold Signal)",
      TRUE ~ "Excluded from the Pipeline"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(Folds_Selected_EN), 
    desc(Folds_Passed_DESeq), 
    desc(abs(coalesce(Median_Beta_Conditional, 0)))
  )

## =============================================================================
## EXPORT RESULTS TO TSV FILE
## =============================================================================
output_file <- "Pipeline_Attrition_Summary_Genes_Seleccionados.tsv"

write.table(
  pipeline_attrition_summary, 
  file = output_file, 
  sep = "\t", 
  row.names = FALSE, 
  quote = FALSE
)

cat("\n--> File successfully saved as:", output_file, "\n")

## =============================================================================
## EXPORT RESULTS TO TSV FILE
## =============================================================================
output_file <- "Pipeline_Attrition_Summary_Genes_Seleccionados.tsv"

# Export the complete gene-level results table
write.table(
  pipeline_attrition_summary, 
  file = output_file, 
  sep = "\t", 
  row.names = FALSE, 
  quote = FALSE
)

cat("\nFile successfully saved as:", output_file, "\n")

## =============================================================================
## PIPELINE TRANSPARENCY REPORT AND ROC CURVE (LAMBDA.1SE ONLY)
## =============================================================================

cat("\n==================================================\n")
cat("PIPELINE TRANSPARENCY REPORT:\n")
cat("==================================================\n")

if (exists("used_planB") && exists("folds")) {
  cat("Fallback strategy used in", sum(used_planB), "of", length(folds), "folds\n")
} else {
  cat("Cross-validation variables were not found in the environment.\n")
}
cat("==================================================\n")

# Pipeline attrition summary
cat("\nTop 15 Biomarkers - PIPELINE ATTRITION SUMMARY:\n")
if (exists("pipeline_attrition_summary")) {
  print(as.data.frame(head(pipeline_attrition_summary, 15)))
} else {
  cat("The 'pipeline_attrition_summary' object does not exist in this session.\n")
}

# ROC curve visualization exclusively for lambda.1se
if (exists("roc_1se") && exists("auc_real_1se")) {
  
  # Helper function for ROC curve plotting
  dibujar_roc <- function() {
    plot(
      roc_1se, 
      legacy.axes = TRUE, 
      col = "darkblue", 
      lwd = 3,
    )
    abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "grey")
    legend(
      "bottomright", 
      legend = paste0("lambda.1se (AUC = ", round(auc_real_1se, 3), ")"), 
      col = "darkblue", 
      lwd = 3,
      bty = "n"
    )
  }
  
  # 1. Display the ROC curve in the R graphics device
  dibujar_roc()
  
  # 2. Export as a high-quality PDF
  cairo_pdf("roc_curve_lambda_1se.pdf", width = 6, height = 6)
  dibujar_roc()
  dev.off()
  
  # 3. Export as a PNG (600 DPI)
  png("roc_curve_lambda_1se.png", width = 6, height = 6, units = "in", res = 600)
  dibujar_roc()
  dev.off()
  
  cat("\n--> ROC curve successfully exported as PDF and PNG.\n")
  
} else {
  warning("The 'roc_1se' or 'auc_real_1se' variables were not found. ROC curve generation was skipped.")
}


## Export gene selection stability for lambda.min
library(dplyr)

stability_file <- file.path(base_dir, "Predictive_gene_stability_summary_lambdaMin_PBMC.tsv")

gene_stability_min <- coefficients_history %>%
  filter(Lambda == "lambda.min", Gene != "(Intercept)") %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(
    Folds_Evaluated = n(),
    Folds_Selected = sum(Beta != 0),
    Selection_Frequency = Folds_Selected / length(folds),
    Mean_Beta = if (any(Beta != 0)) mean(Beta[Beta != 0]) else NA_real_,
    Median_Beta = if (any(Beta != 0)) median(Beta[Beta != 0]) else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Selection_Frequency), desc(abs(Mean_Beta)))

write.table(gene_stability_min, file = stability_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
message("Gene stability summary exported: ", normalizePath(stability_file))

```

```{r}
############################################################
## STANDALONE SCRIPT: ROC CURVE GENERATION AND CONFIDENCE INTERVALS
## Independent execution based on GENES-ONLY model predictions
############################################################

library(pROC)
library(utils)

# 1. Configure paths (ensure consistency with the main analysis base_dir)

## Preserve the directory configured in the main analysis
if (!exists("base_dir")) stop("ERROR: base_dir is not defined.")
pred_file <- file.path(base_dir, "Predictive_model_GENES_ONLY_predictions.tsv")

if (!file.exists(pred_file)) {
  stop("ERROR: Prediction file not found at: ", normalizePath(pred_file, mustWork = FALSE))
}

pred_file <- file.path(base_dir, "Predictive_model_GENES_ONLY_predictions.tsv")

if (!file.exists(pred_file)) {
  stop("ERROR: Genes-only prediction file not found. Run the genes-only predictive model first.")
}

# 2. Load out-of-fold predictions from the final model
preds_df <- read.table(pred_file, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 3. Reconstruct ROC objects identical to those generated during cross-validation
roc_min <- pROC::roc(response = preds_df$y_bin, predictor = preds_df$pred_lambda_min, levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)
roc_1se <- pROC::roc(response = preds_df$y_bin, predictor = preds_df$pred_lambda_1se, levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)

auc_min <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_min))
auc_1se <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_1se))

# 4. Calculate 95% confidence intervals for cross-validated AUC estimates
set.seed(42) # Ensure reproducibility
ci_min <- pROC::ci.auc(roc_min)
ci_1se <- pROC::ci.auc(roc_1se)

# 5. Plot ROC curves using conventional axes
plot(
  roc_min, 
  legacy.axes = TRUE, 
  col = "#1F78B4",   # Blue: genes-only model
  lwd = 3, 
  main = "Cross-validated ROC – GENES-ONLY Model\n(RNA-seq Baseline PBMC)"
)

# Overlay the lambda.1se ROC curve as a dashed green line for comparison
plot(roc_1se, legacy.axes = TRUE, col = "#33A02C", lwd = 2, lty = 2, add = TRUE)
abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "grey")

# 6. Annotate the figure with AUC estimates and 95% confidence intervals
text(
  x = 0.45, y = 0.22, 
  labels = paste0("lambda.min AUC = ", round(auc_min, 3), "\n95% CI: [", round(ci_min[1], 2), " - ", round(ci_min[3], 2), "]"),
  cex = 1.0, adj = 0, font = 2 # Bold text
)

text(
  x = 0.45, y = 0.08, 
  labels = paste0("lambda.1se AUC = ", round(auc_1se, 3), "\n95% CI: [", round(ci_1se[1], 2), " - ", round(ci_1se[3], 2), "]"),
  cex = 0.85, col = "#555555", adj = 0
)

# Optional: Print AUC estimates and confidence intervals for manuscript reporting
cat("\n==================================================\n")
cat("GENES-ONLY MODEL PERFORMANCE METRICS FOR THE MANUSCRIPT:\n")
cat("==================================================\n")
cat(paste0("Model lambda.min: AUC = ", round(auc_min, 3), " (95% CI: ", round(ci_min[1], 3), "-", round(ci_min[3], 3), ")\n"))
cat(paste0("Model lambda.1se: AUC = ", round(auc_1se, 3), " (95% CI: ", round(ci_1se[1], 3), "-", round(ci_1se[3], 3), ")\n"))
cat("==================================================\n")
```

```{r}
################################################################################
## ANALYSIS 2: COMPREHENSIVE BIOMARKER STABILITY (INDEPENDENT BOOTSTRAP)
## Objective: Assess genome-wide molecular robustness without prior feature selection
################################################################################

library(glmnet)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(edgeR)
library(parallel)
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)

## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 1) Prepare the Baseline Matrix and Implement Data Integrity Checks
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
message("Preparing an outcome-agnostic expression matrix to prevent data leakage...")

# Retrieve raw counts from the dds object
counts_raw <- counts(dds)

# [CORRECTIONS 1 AND 2] Enforce strict sample alignment and define an atomic response vector
stopifnot(identical(colnames(counts_raw), rownames(col_data)))

y <- ifelse(col_data$condition == "HESN", 1, 0)
y <- unname(y)

stopifnot(length(y) == ncol(counts_raw))

# Minimum expression filtering based exclusively on technical criteria (outcome-agnostic)
keep_counts <- rowSums(counts_raw >= 10) >= 15
counts_filtered <- counts_raw[keep_counts, ]

# Global TMM normalization to obtain a consistent logCPM expression scale
dge_global <- DGEList(counts = counts_filtered)
dge_global <- calcNormFactors(dge_global, method = "TMM")
X_global   <- t(cpm(dge_global, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)) # Final matrix (Samples x Genes)

n <- nrow(X_global)
cat("Outcome-agnostic matrix ready. Samples:", n, "| Total candidate genes:", ncol(X_global), "\n")

## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 2) Parallel Bootstrap Engine (Computational Cost Management)
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# [CORRECTION 3] Use 50 replicates for testing and 500 for the final manuscript analysis
B <- 500 

num_cores <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 2)
cl <- makeCluster(num_cores)
registerDoParallel(cl)

message("Starting ", B, " parallel bootstrap replicates using ", num_cores, " CPU cores...")

clusterExport(cl, varlist = c("X_global", "y", "n"), envir = environment())

boot_list <- foreach(b = 1:B, .packages = c("glmnet"), .errorhandling = "pass") %dopar% {
  
  set.seed(888 + b)
  
  # Bootstrap resampling with replacement
  idx <- sample(seq_len(n), size = n, replace = TRUE)
  Xb  <- X_global[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  yb  <- y[idx]
  
  if (length(unique(yb)) < 2) return(NULL)
  
  # Internal cross-validation to optimize lambda within each bootstrap replicate
  cv_b <- cv.glmnet(
    x = Xb, y = yb,
    family = "binomial",
    alpha = 0.5,
    nfolds = 3,
    type.measure = "deviance",
    standardize = TRUE # [CORRECTION 4] Explicitly specified for methodological rigor
  )
  
  co <- as.matrix(coef(cv_b, s = "lambda.1se"))
  
  data.frame(
    Gene = rownames(co),
    Beta = as.numeric(co[, 1]),
    Replica = b,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

stopCluster(cl)
message("Bootstrap replicates completed. Consolidating results and computing summary statistics...")

## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 3) Consolidate Results and Calculate Conditional Selection Metrics
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
boot_validos <- boot_list[sapply(boot_list, function(x) is.data.frame(x))]
B_efectivo   <- length(boot_validos)

boot_flat <- bind_rows(boot_validos)

boot_summary <- boot_flat %>%
  filter(Gene != "(Intercept)") %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(
    Frecuencia_Seleccion = sum(Beta != 0),
    Porcentaje_Estabilidad = (Frecuencia_Seleccion / B_efectivo) * 100,
    
    Mean_Beta_Conditional   = ifelse(Frecuencia_Seleccion > 0, mean(Beta[Beta != 0]), NA_real_),
    Median_Beta_Conditional = ifelse(Frecuencia_Seleccion > 0, median(Beta[Beta != 0]), NA_real_),
    SD_Beta_Conditional     = ifelse(Frecuencia_Seleccion > 1, sd(Beta[Beta != 0]), NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # [DIRECTIONAL INTERPRETATION REFINEMENT] Use mathematically precise terminology for predictive coefficients
  mutate(
    Clinical_Sign = case_when(
      coalesce(Mean_Beta_Conditional, 0) > 0 ~ "Higher score in HESN",
      coalesce(Mean_Beta_Conditional, 0) < 0 ~ "Higher score in HIV",
      TRUE ~ "Not selected"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Porcentaje_Estabilidad), desc(abs(coalesce(Median_Beta_Conditional, 0))))

## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 4) Export Results and Generate Summary Report
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
write.table(
  boot_summary, 
  file = "Firma_Robustez_Bootstrap_Global_SinSesgo.tsv", 
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=========================================================================\n")
cat("GLOBAL BIOMARKER STABILITY ANALYSIS COMPLETED (Successful replicates:", B_efectivo, ")\n")
cat("=========================================================================\n")

print(as.data.frame(head(boot_summary, 25)))
```


```{r}
################################################################################
## ANALYSIS 2.5: EXPORTABLE FINAL PREDICTIVE MODEL
##
## Objective:
## Train a single Elastic Net classifier using all 104 samples,
## using only stable biomarkers identified by bootstrap.
##
## IMPORTANT:
## - This block generates the final exportable model.
## - The AUC calculated here using the 104 training samples is APPARENT.
## - The primary performance estimate must remain the out-of-fold AUC obtained
##   previously through leakage-free cross-validation.
################################################################################

library(glmnet)
library(pROC)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

## =============================================================================
## 0. REQUIRED OBJECTS
## =============================================================================
##
## boot_summary:
##   table containing at least:
##     Gene
##     Porcentaje_Estabilidad
##
## X_global:
##   numeric matrix of normalized expression:
##     rows    = samples
##     columns = genes
##
## col_data:
##   metadata aligned with the rows of X_global
##   must contain:
##     condition, con niveles HIV/HESN
##
## base_dir:
##   output directory for results
##
## =============================================================================

stopifnot(exists("boot_summary"))
stopifnot(exists("X_global"))
stopifnot(exists("col_data"))
stopifnot(exists("base_dir"))

X_global <- as.matrix(X_global)

if (!all(c("Gene", "Porcentaje_Estabilidad") %in% colnames(boot_summary))) {
  stop(
    "boot_summary must contain the columns ",
    "'Gene' y 'Porcentaje_Estabilidad'."
  )
}

if (!"condition" %in% colnames(col_data)) {
  stop("col_data must contain a column named 'condition'.")
}

if (is.null(rownames(X_global))) {
  stop("X_global must have sample identifiers as row names.")
}

if (is.null(colnames(X_global))) {
  stop("X_global must have gene identifiers as column names.")
}

stopifnot(identical(rownames(X_global), rownames(col_data)))

## =============================================================================
## 1. STABLE BIOMARKER SELECTION
## =============================================================================

UMBRAL_ESTABILIDAD <- 40

biomarcadores_estables <- boot_summary %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Gene),
    Gene != "",
    !is.na(Porcentaje_Estabilidad),
    Porcentaje_Estabilidad >= UMBRAL_ESTABILIDAD
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Porcentaje_Estabilidad)) %>%
  pull(Gene) %>%
  unique()

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("STABLE BIOMARKER SELECTION\n")
cat("============================================================\n")
cat("Stability threshold:", UMBRAL_ESTABILIDAD, "%\n")
cat("Genes meeting the threshold:", length(biomarcadores_estables), "\n")

if (length(biomarcadores_estables) < 3) {
  stop(
    "Fewer than 3 genes meet the stability threshold. ",
    "Review the threshold before building the final model."
  )
}

## =============================================================================
## 2. CHECK GENE AVAILABILITY IN X_global
## =============================================================================

genes_missing <- setdiff(
  biomarcadores_estables,
  colnames(X_global)
)

if (length(genes_missing) > 0) {
  warning(
    length(genes_missing),
    " bootstrap signature genes are absent from X_global:\n",
    paste(genes_missing, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

## Strictly preserve the ordering defined by bootstrap stability
genes_finales <- biomarcadores_estables[
  biomarcadores_estables %in% colnames(X_global)
]

if (length(genes_finales) < 3) {
  stop(
    "Fewer than 3 genes remain available after checking X_global."
  )
}

cat("Genes available in X_global:", length(genes_finales), "\n")
cat("Missing genes:", length(genes_missing), "\n")

## =============================================================================
## 3. CONSTRUCT THE FINAL INPUT MATRIX
## =============================================================================

X_final <- X_global[
  ,
  genes_finales,
  drop = FALSE
]

## Response variable
y_factor <- factor(
  col_data$condition,
  levels = c("HIV", "HESN")
)

y_final <- ifelse(y_factor == "HESN", 1, 0)
y_final <- unname(as.numeric(y_final))

## Data integrity checks
stopifnot(nrow(X_final) == length(y_final))
stopifnot(identical(colnames(X_final), genes_finales))
stopifnot(identical(rownames(X_final), rownames(col_data)))

if (anyNA(X_final)) {
  stop("X_final contains NA values.")
}

if (!all(is.finite(X_final))) {
  stop("X_final contains non-finite values.")
}

if (length(unique(y_final)) != 2) {
  stop("The response variable does not contain both classes.")
}

cat("\nClass distribution:\n")
print(table(y_factor))

cat("\nX_final dimensions:\n")
print(dim(X_final))

## =============================================================================
## 4. FIT THE FINAL ELASTIC NET MODEL USING ALL 104 SAMPLES
## =============================================================================
##
## Retained setting:
##   alpha = 0.5
## because this configuration was previously validated.
##
## Selected setting:
##   lambda.1se
## because it generally yields a more parsimonious model and showed
## better out-of-fold performance in the previous analysis.
##
## =============================================================================

set.seed(42)

cv_final <- cv.glmnet(
  x = X_final,
  y = y_final,
  family = "binomial",
  alpha = 0.5,
  nfolds = 5,
  type.measure = "deviance",
  standardize = TRUE,
  keep = TRUE
)

lambda_final <- cv_final$lambda.1se

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("FINAL MODEL FITTING\n")
cat("============================================================\n")
cat("Alpha:", 0.5, "\n")
cat("Lambda.min:", cv_final$lambda.min, "\n")
cat("Selected lambda.1se:", lambda_final, "\n")

## =============================================================================
## 5. EXTRACT FINAL MODEL COEFFICIENTS
## =============================================================================

coef_final <- as.matrix(
  coef(
    cv_final,
    s = "lambda.1se"
  )
)

df_coef_final <- data.frame(
  Gene = rownames(coef_final),
  Beta_Final = as.numeric(coef_final[, 1]),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  left_join(
    boot_summary,
    by = "Gene"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Seleccionado_Modelo_Final =
      Gene == "(Intercept)" | Beta_Final != 0,

    Direccion = case_when(
      Gene == "(Intercept)" ~
        "Intercept",

      Beta_Final > 0 ~
        "Higher score toward HESN",

      Beta_Final < 0 ~
        "Higher score toward HIV",

      TRUE ~
        "Zero coefficient"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(Beta_Final)))

## Genes with nonzero coefficients in the final equation
firma_modelo_final <- df_coef_final %>%
  filter(
    Gene != "(Intercept)",
    Beta_Final != 0
  )

cat("\nCandidate genes from bootstrap:",
    length(genes_finales), "\n")

cat("Genes with nonzero coefficients in the final model:",
    nrow(firma_modelo_final), "\n")

cat("\nActive genes in the final classifier:\n")
print(firma_modelo_final$Gene)

## =============================================================================
## 6. APPARENT PREDICTION ON ALL 104 TRAINING SAMPLES
## =============================================================================
##
## This evaluation does NOT replace the out-of-fold AUC.
## It is calculated solely to describe the final model fit.
##
## =============================================================================

prob_aparente <- as.numeric(
  predict(
    cv_final,
    newx = X_final,
    s = "lambda.1se",
    type = "response"
  )
)

roc_aparente <- pROC::roc(
  response = y_final,
  predictor = prob_aparente,
  levels = c(0, 1),
  direction = "<",
  quiet = TRUE
)

auc_aparente <- as.numeric(
  pROC::auc(roc_aparente)
)

ci_auc_aparente <- as.numeric(
  pROC::ci.auc(roc_aparente)
)

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("APPARENT PERFORMANCE OF THE FINAL MODEL\n")
cat("============================================================\n")
cat("Apparent AUC:", round(auc_aparente, 3), "\n")
cat(
  "Apparent 95% CI:",
  round(ci_auc_aparente[1], 3), "-",
  round(ci_auc_aparente[3], 3), "\n"
)
cat("\nWARNING:\n")
cat(
  "This AUC was calculated using the same 104 samples used to\n",
  "fit the model and is therefore optimistic.\n",
  "The primary performance estimate must be the leakage-free out-of-fold AUC\n",
  "estimated previously.\n"
)

## =============================================================================
## 7. APPARENT YOUDEN THRESHOLD
## =============================================================================
##
## Stored for descriptive reference only.
## It does not replace an externally validated threshold.
##
## =============================================================================

threshold_aparente <- as.numeric(
  pROC::coords(
    roc_aparente,
    x = "best",
    best.method = "youden",
    ret = "threshold"
  )
)[1]

pred_class_aparente <- factor(
  ifelse(prob_aparente >= threshold_aparente, 1, 0),
  levels = c(0, 1),
  labels = c("HIV", "HESN")
)

real_class <- factor(
  y_final,
  levels = c(0, 1),
  labels = c("HIV", "HESN")
)

cm_aparente <- caret::confusionMatrix(
  data = pred_class_aparente,
  reference = real_class,
  positive = "HESN"
)

metricas_aparentes <- data.frame(
  AUC_Aparente = auc_aparente,
  AUC_CI95_Lower = ci_auc_aparente[1],
  AUC_CI95_Upper = ci_auc_aparente[3],
  Youden_Threshold_Aparente = threshold_aparente,
  Accuracy_Aparente = as.numeric(cm_aparente$overall["Accuracy"]),
  Sensitivity_Aparente = as.numeric(cm_aparente$byClass["Sensitivity"]),
  Specificity_Aparente = as.numeric(cm_aparente$byClass["Specificity"]),
  PPV_Aparente = as.numeric(cm_aparente$byClass["Pos Pred Value"]),
  NPV_Aparente = as.numeric(cm_aparente$byClass["Neg Pred Value"]),
  F1_Aparente = as.numeric(cm_aparente$byClass["F1"])
)

## =============================================================================
## 8. FINAL MODEL PREDICTIONS TABLE
## =============================================================================

predicciones_finales <- data.frame(
  Sample = rownames(X_final),
  Condition = y_factor,
  y_bin = y_final,
  Probability_HESN_Aparent = prob_aparente,
  Predicted_Class_Aparent = pred_class_aparente,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

## =============================================================================
## 9. SAVE THE COMPLETE CLASSIFIER BUNDLE
## =============================================================================

model_bundle <- list(

  ## glmnet/cv.glmnet model
  model = cv_final,

  ## Input signature
  genes_input = genes_finales,

  ## Genes with nonzero beta coefficients
  genes_active = firma_modelo_final$Gene,

  ## Full coefficients, including the intercept
  coefficients = df_coef_final,

  ## Model parameters
  alpha = 0.5,
  lambda = lambda_final,
  lambda_rule = "lambda.1se",

  ## Bootstrap criterion
  stability_cutoff = UMBRAL_ESTABILIDAD,

  ## Classes
  positive_class = "HESN",
  negative_class = "HIV",

  ## Descriptive apparent threshold
  apparent_youden_threshold = threshold_aparente,

  ## Apparent performance
  apparent_auc = auc_aparente,
  apparent_auc_ci95 = ci_auc_aparente,

  ## Preprocessing information
  preprocessing = list(
    input_object = "X_global",
    matrix_orientation = "samples_x_genes",
    gene_order = genes_finales,
    glmnet_standardize = TRUE,
    missing_gene_policy = "Error: all genes_input must be present",
    note = paste(
      "X_global must be reproduced exactly using the same",
      "normalization procedure used during training."
    )
  ),

  ## Training information
  training = list(
    n_samples = nrow(X_final),
    class_distribution = table(y_factor),
    sample_ids = rownames(X_final),
    random_seed = 42
  ),

  ## Software environment versions
  session_info = sessionInfo()
)

saveRDS(
  model_bundle,
  file = file.path(
    base_dir,
    "Clasificador_Final_ElasticNet_PBMC_bundle.rds"
  )
)

## =============================================================================
## 10. EXPORT TABLES
## =============================================================================

write.table(
  df_coef_final,
  file = file.path(
    base_dir,
    "Clasificador_Final_ElasticNet_Coeficientes_Completos.tsv"
  ),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.table(
  firma_modelo_final,
  file = file.path(
    base_dir,
    "Clasificador_Final_ElasticNet_Genes_Activos.tsv"
  ),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.table(
  data.frame(
    Gene = genes_finales,
    Order = seq_along(genes_finales)
  ),
  file = file.path(
    base_dir,
    "Clasificador_Final_ElasticNet_Orden_Genes_Entrada.tsv"
  ),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.table(
  predicciones_finales,
  file = file.path(
    base_dir,
    "Clasificador_Final_ElasticNet_Predicciones_Aparentes.tsv"
  ),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.table(
  metricas_aparentes,
  file = file.path(
    base_dir,
    "Clasificador_Final_ElasticNet_Metricas_Aparentes.tsv"
  ),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.table(
  data.frame(
    Gene_Missing = genes_missing
  ),
  file = file.path(
    base_dir,
    "Clasificador_Final_ElasticNet_Genes_Ausentes.tsv"
  ),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

## =============================================================================
## 11. VISUALIZATION
## =============================================================================

plot(
  roc_aparente,
  legacy.axes = TRUE,
  lwd = 3,
  main = paste0(
    "Final Elastic Net model — apparent ROC\n",
    "AUC = ",
    round(auc_aparente, 3)
  )
)

abline(
  a = 0,
  b = 1,
  lty = 2
)

plot(cv_final)
title(
  "Final model lambda selection",
  line = 2.5
)

## =============================================================================
## 12. FINAL REPORT
## =============================================================================

cat("\n=========================================================================\n")
cat("FINAL ELASTIC NET CLASSIFIER GENERATED\n")
cat("=========================================================================\n")
cat("Samples used:", nrow(X_final), "\n")
cat("Bootstrap threshold:", UMBRAL_ESTABILIDAD, "%\n")
cat("Candidate genes:", length(genes_finales), "\n")
cat("Active genes:", nrow(firma_modelo_final), "\n")
cat("Alpha:", 0.5, "\n")
cat("Selected lambda:", lambda_final, "\n")
cat("Lambda rule: lambda.1se\n")
cat("Apparent AUC:", round(auc_aparente, 3), "\n")
cat("=========================================================================\n")
cat(
  "The AUC reported as primary performance must be the one obtained\n",
  "previously through leakage-free out-of-fold cross-validation.\n"
)
cat("=========================================================================\n")

kable(
  firma_modelo_final,
  caption = "Active genes and coefficients of the final classifier"
)
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

## -----------------------------------------
## Genes of interest
## -----------------------------------------

genes <- c(
"SYNE1", "UTRN", "C8orf88", "STMN1", "ZNF804A", "CEMIP2", "TNNC1", "BIRC5", "IFI44L", "CLEC2L", "CD38", "PCLAF", "GBP1", "IFI27", "TMEM155", "TRBV7-1", "SERPING1"
)

## -----------------------------------------
## Check gene availability
## -----------------------------------------


## Retrieve normalized baseline expression
if (exists("vsd")) {
  expr_mat <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(vsd)
} else if (exists("dds")) {
  vsd_corr <- DESeq2::vst(dds, blind = TRUE)
  expr_mat <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(vsd_corr)
} else {
  stop("ERROR: Neither 'vsd' nor 'dds' is available.")
}

## Verify gene identifiers and sample alignment
stopifnot(is.matrix(expr_mat), !is.null(rownames(expr_mat)))
cat("Expression matrix dimensions:", paste(dim(expr_mat), collapse = " x "), "\n")
cat("First gene identifiers:", paste(head(rownames(expr_mat)), collapse = ", "), "\n")


genes_present <- intersect(genes, rownames(expr_mat))
genes_missing <- setdiff(genes, rownames(expr_mat))

cat("Genes present:", length(genes_present), "\n")
cat("Genes missing:", length(genes_missing), "\n")

if(length(genes_missing) > 0){
  print(genes_missing)
}

## -----------------------------------------
## Expression matrix
## -----------------------------------------

expr_sel <- t(expr_mat[genes_present, , drop = FALSE])

## -----------------------------------------
## Spearman correlation
## -----------------------------------------

cor_mat <- cor(
  expr_sel,
  method = "spearman",
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)

## -----------------------------------------
## Heatmap
## -----------------------------------------

pheatmap(
  cor_mat,
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  clustering_method = "complete",
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%.2f",
  fontsize_number = 8,
  border_color = NA,
  main = "Spearman correlation among candidate genes"
)

## -----------------------------------------
## Export correlation matrix
## -----------------------------------------

write.table(
  cor_mat,
  file = file.path(base_dir, "Correlation_matrix_bootstrap_genes.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE
)
```
