```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

## =============================================================================
## 1. LOAD THE CORRECT TSV FILE
## =============================================================================
file_path <- "Clasificador_Final_ElasticNet_Coeficientes_Completos.tsv"

if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
  stop("The file 'Clasificador_Final_ElasticNet_Coeficientes_Completos.tsv' does not exist in the current working directory.")
}

# Read the tab-delimited input file
df_raw <- read_tsv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

## =============================================================================
## 2. EXCLUDE THE INTERCEPT AND PREPARE THE DATA
## =============================================================================
plot_data <- df_raw %>%
  # Exclude the intercept and retain valid observations
  filter(Gene != "(Intercept)", !is.na(Porcentaje_Estabilidad)) %>%
  # Retain genes selected in the final model
  filter(Seleccionado_Modelo_Final == TRUE | Seleccionado_Modelo_Final == "TRUE") %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert stability percentage (e.g., 84.4) to selection frequency (0.84)
    sel_freq = as.numeric(Porcentaje_Estabilidad) / 100,
    Beta_Final = as.numeric(Beta_Final),
    # Classify genes according to the direction of their association
    Group = ifelse(Beta_Final > 0, "HESN-associated (Beta > 0)", "HIV-1 risk-associated (Beta < 0)")
  ) %>%
  # Sort genes by increasing selection frequency for the flipped-coordinate plot
  arrange(sel_freq, abs(Beta_Final)) %>%
  mutate(Gene = factor(Gene, levels = unique(Gene)))

cat("--> Genes successfully processed for plotting (N =", nrow(plot_data), "):\n")
print(as.character(plot_data$Gene))

## =============================================================================
## 3. GENERATE THE LOLLIPOP PLOT
## =============================================================================
p_stability <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Gene, y = sel_freq)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(xend = Gene, yend = 0),
    linewidth = 0.8,
    color = "grey75"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Group),
    size = 4.2
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "HESN-associated (Beta > 0)" = "#2166AC",
      "HIV-1 risk-associated (Beta < 0)" = "#B2182B"
    ),
    name = "Association Direction"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", sel_freq)),
    hjust = -0.3,
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0.50,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.7,
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.15), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Bootstrap Stability of the Final Elastic Net Signature",
    subtitle = paste0("Selection frequency across bootstrap iterations (B = 500) for all ", nrow(plot_data), " predictor genes"),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Selection Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, face = "italic", color = "grey30"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )

# Display the plot
print(p_stability)

## =============================================================================
## 4. EXPORT HIGH-RESOLUTION FIGURES
## =============================================================================
ggsave("gene_stability_bootstrap_17genes_600dpi.png", plot = p_stability, width = 7.5, height = 7.0, dpi = 600)
ggsave("gene_stability_bootstrap_17genes.pdf", plot = p_stability, width = 7.5, height = 7.0, device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)
library(dplyr)
library(grid)

## =============================================================================
## 1. EXTRACT BOOTSTRAP-SELECTED GENES (AUTOMATIC COLUMN DETECTION)
## =============================================================================
df_boot <- as.data.frame(pipeline_attrition_summary)

# Automatically identify gene and coefficient columns (Gene / Feature)
col_gene <- grep("Gene|Feature|gene|feature", colnames(df_boot), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)[1]
col_beta <- grep("Mean_Beta|Beta", colnames(df_boot), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)[1]

if (is.na(col_gene) || is.na(col_beta)) {
  stop("Gene or beta coefficient columns were not found in 'pipeline_attrition_summary'. Available columns: ",
       paste(colnames(df_boot), collapse = ", "))
}

cat("Detected gene column:", col_gene, "\n")
cat("Detected beta column:", col_beta, "\n")

# Calculate or filter by selection frequency/stability
if ("Folds_Selected_EN" %in% colnames(df_boot)) {
  max_folds <- max(df_boot$Folds_Selected_EN, na.rm = TRUE)
  df_boot$freq_prop <- df_boot$Folds_Selected_EN / max_folds
  df_filtered <- df_boot %>% filter(freq_prop >= 0.70)
} else if (any(grep("Estabilidad|stability", colnames(df_boot), ignore.case = TRUE))) {
  col_stab <- grep("Estabilidad|stability", colnames(df_boot), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)[1]
  df_filtered <- df_boot %>% filter(.data[[col_stab]] >= 40)
} else {
  df_filtered <- df_boot
}

# Extract genes ordered by their beta coefficients
genes_12 <- df_filtered %>%
  arrange(desc(.data[[col_beta]])) %>%
  pull(.data[[col_gene]]) %>%
  as.character()

# Processed expression matrix
mat_exp_raw <- if (exists("logCPM_global")) logCPM_global else vst_mat

# Check gene availability in the expression matrix
genes_validos <- intersect(genes_12, rownames(mat_exp_raw))

cat("Genes extracted for the heatmap (N = ", length(genes_validos), "):\n", sep = "")
print(genes_validos)

if (length(genes_validos) == 0) {
  stop("None of the selected genes match the row names of the expression matrix.")
}

## =============================================================================
## 2. PREPARE SAMPLE ANNOTATIONS (HESN vs HIV)
## =============================================================================
df_meta <- if (exists("col_data")) as.data.frame(col_data) else as.data.frame(col_data_global)

# Ensure correct sample identifiers in metadata row names
if ("sampleID" %in% colnames(df_meta)) {
  rownames(df_meta) <- df_meta$sampleID
} else if ("sample" %in% colnames(df_meta)) {
  rownames(df_meta) <- df_meta$sample
}

muestras_comunes <- intersect(rownames(df_meta), colnames(mat_exp_raw))

if (length(muestras_comunes) == 0) {
  stop("No matching sample identifiers were found between metadata and the expression matrix.")
}

col_cond <- grep("condition|grupo|group", colnames(df_meta), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]

anno_df <- data.frame(
  Grupo = as.character(df_meta[muestras_comunes, col_cond]),
  row.names = muestras_comunes,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>% arrange(Grupo) # Group HESN and HIV samples

muestras_ordenadas <- rownames(anno_df)

## =============================================================================
## 3. CALCULATE GENE-WISE Z-SCORES AND CAP VALUES (-3 TO +3)
## =============================================================================
mat_sub <- as.matrix(mat_exp_raw[genes_validos, muestras_ordenadas, drop = FALSE])

# Calculate row-wise Z-scores
mat_zscore <- t(scale(t(mat_sub)))
mat_zscore[is.na(mat_zscore) | is.nan(mat_zscore) | is.infinite(mat_zscore)] <- 0

# Cap extreme Z-score values
limite_z <- 3
mat_plot <- pmin(pmax(mat_zscore, -limite_z), limite_z)

## =============================================================================
## 4. GENERATE AND EXPORT THE HEATMAP (ROBUST EXPORT PROCEDURE)
## =============================================================================
grupos_presentes <- unique(anno_df$Grupo)
colores_base <- c("HESN" = "#377EB8", "HIV" = "#E41A1C")
colores_anotacion <- list(Grupo = colores_base[names(colores_base) %in% grupos_presentes])

# --- A) EXPORT TO PDF ---
pdf("signature_heatmap.pdf", width = 8, height = 5)

pheatmap(
  mat_plot,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,         # Preserve gene ordering by beta coefficient
  cluster_cols = FALSE,         # Keep HESN and HIV samples grouped
  scale = "none",               # Z-scores have already been calculated
  annotation_col = anno_df,
  annotation_colors = colores_anotacion,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "#F7F7F7", "#B2182B"))(100),
  breaks = seq(-limite_z, limite_z, length.out = 101),
  main = paste0("Expression Profile of Selected Biomarkers (N = ", length(genes_validos), ")"),
  show_colnames = FALSE,        # Hide sample identifiers
  show_rownames = TRUE,         # Display gene symbols
  fontsize_row = 10,
  fontsize = 11,
  border_color = NA
)

dev.off() # Close the graphics device and save the PDF

# --- B) EXPORT TO PNG (600 DPI) ---
png("signature_heatmap_600dpi.png", width = 8, height = 5, units = "in", res = 600)

pheatmap(
  mat_plot,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  scale = "none",
  annotation_col = anno_df,
  annotation_colors = colores_anotacion,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "#F7F7F7", "#B2182B"))(100),
  breaks = seq(-limite_z, limite_z, length.out = 101),
  main = paste0("Expression Profile of Selected Biomarkers (N = ", length(genes_validos), ")"),
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 10,
  fontsize = 11,
  border_color = NA
)

dev.off() # Close the graphics device and save the PNG

# --- C) DISPLAY THE HEATMAP ---
pheatmap(
  mat_plot,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  scale = "none",
  annotation_col = anno_df,
  annotation_colors = colores_anotacion,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "#F7F7F7", "#B2182B"))(100),
  breaks = seq(-limite_z, limite_z, length.out = 101),
  main = paste0("Expression Profile of Selected Biomarkers (N = ", length(genes_validos), ")"),
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 10,
  fontsize = 11,
  border_color = NA
)

cat("\nHeatmap successfully exported to PDF and PNG (600 DPI)!\n")
```

```{r}
# REACTOME PATHWAY ENRICHMENT ANALYSIS

library(clusterProfiler)
library(ReactomePA)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

# Load differentially expressed genes upregulated in each group
hesn_up <- read.delim(
  "DESeq2_HESN_up_noCell.tsv",
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
hiv_up <- read.delim(
  "DESeq2_HIV_up_noCell.tsv",
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

HESN_up <- hesn_up$gene
HIV_up  <- hiv_up$gene

# Convert HESN-upregulated gene symbols to Entrez IDs
hesn_df <- bitr(
  HESN_up,
  fromType = "SYMBOL",
  toType   = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db
)

# Convert HIV-upregulated gene symbols to Entrez IDs
hiv_df <- bitr(
  HIV_up,
  fromType = "SYMBOL",
  toType = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
)

# Load the complete DESeq2 results to define the background gene universe
all_res <- read.delim(
  "DESeq2_results_condition_noCell.tsv",
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
colnames(all_res)
nrow(all_res)
head(all_res$gene)

library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

# Define the background gene universe
background_genes <- all_res$gene

# Convert background gene symbols to Entrez IDs
universe_df <- bitr(
  background_genes,
  fromType = "SYMBOL",
  toType   = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db
)

# Reactome pathway enrichment for HESN-upregulated genes
reactome_hesn <- enrichPathway(
  gene          = hesn_df$ENTREZID,
  universe      = universe_df$ENTREZID,
  organism      = "human",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.2,
  readable      = TRUE
)

# Reactome pathway enrichment for HIV-upregulated genes
reactome_hiv <- enrichPathway(
  gene          = hiv_df$ENTREZID,
  universe      = universe_df$ENTREZID,
  organism      = "human",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.2,
  readable      = TRUE
)

# Display Reactome enrichment results
reactome_hesn
reactome_hiv

# Export enrichment results as tab-delimited files
write.table(reactome_hesn, "reactome.hesn.txt", quote = FALSE, sep = "\t")
write.table(reactome_hiv, "reactome.hiv.txt", quote = FALSE, sep = "\t")
```

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)

library(dplyr)

## =============================================================================
## STEP B0: RECONSTRUCT DF_SURV FROM PBMC METADATA
## =============================================================================

metadata_surv <- read.table(
  "metadata.full.2.txt",
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

df_surv <- metadata_surv %>%
  mutate(
    event = ifelse(condition == "HIV", 1L, 0L)
  )

cat("\n--- RECONSTRUCTED DF_SURV ---\n")
cat("Samples:", nrow(df_surv), "\n")

## Verify survival metadata and required columns
required_surv_vars <- c("sampleID", "condition", "TTS", "age", "risk")
missing_surv_vars <- setdiff(required_surv_vars, colnames(df_surv))
if (length(missing_surv_vars) > 0) stop("ERROR: Missing survival metadata columns: ", paste(missing_surv_vars, collapse = ", "))
print(head(df_surv[, required_surv_vars, drop = FALSE]))


## =============================================================================
## STEP A: EXTRACT THE ELASTIC NET SCORE (THREE ALTERNATIVE SOURCES)
## =============================================================================

# OPTION 1: Retrieve predictions from 'predicciones_finales' if Analysis 2.5 has already been executed
if (exists("predicciones_finales") && "Probability_HESN_Aparent" %in% colnames(predicciones_finales)) {

  message("--> Retrieving scores from the 'predicciones_finales' object...")
  df_scores <- predicciones_finales %>%
    transmute(
      sampleID = Sample,
      en_score = Probability_HESN_Aparent
    )

# OPTION 2: Load predictions from the previously exported TSV file
} else if (file.exists(file.path(base_dir, "Clasificador_Final_ElasticNet_Predicciones_Aparentes.tsv"))) {

  message("--> Loading scores from the exported TSV file...")
  tsv_pred <- read.table(
    file.path(base_dir, "Clasificador_Final_ElasticNet_Predicciones_Aparentes.tsv"),
    header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  df_scores <- tsv_pred %>%
    transmute(
      sampleID = Sample,
      en_score = Probability_HESN_Aparent
    )

# OPTION 3: Generate predictions directly from 'cv_final' and 'X_final'
} else if (exists("cv_final") && exists("X_final")) {

  message("--> Computing en_score directly using cv_final and X_final...")
  prob_scores <- as.numeric(predict(cv_final, newx = X_final, s = "lambda.1se", type = "response"))
  df_scores <- data.frame(
    sampleID = rownames(X_final),
    en_score = prob_scores,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

} else {
  stop("ERROR: Neither 'predicciones_finales', the exported TSV file, nor 'cv_final' was found. Run Analysis 2.5 first.")
}

## =============================================================================
## STEP B: MERGE THE ELASTIC NET SCORE INTO DF_SURV
## =============================================================================

if ("en_score" %in% colnames(df_surv)) {
  df_surv$en_score <- NULL
}

df_surv <- df_surv %>%
  left_join(df_scores, by = "sampleID")

cat("\n=================================================================\n")
cat("SUCCESS: The 'en_score' column has been successfully merged into df_surv.\n")
cat("Total samples with available scores for survival analysis:", sum(!is.na(df_surv$en_score)), "out of", nrow(df_surv), "\n")
cat("=================================================================\n\n")

# Display a preview for verification
print(head(df_surv %>% select(sampleID, TTS, event, en_score)))

## =============================================================================
## 1. CALCULATE THE SEROCONVERSION RISK SCORE AND DEFINE TERTILES
## =============================================================================

# Reverse the score so that higher values indicate greater seroconversion risk
df_surv$en_risk_score_real <- -1 * df_surv$en_score

p_terciles <- quantile(df_surv$en_risk_score_real, probs = c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1), na.rm = TRUE)

# Use simple tertile labels to avoid special-character issues in ggplot2
df_surv$Grupo_KM <- cut(
  df_surv$en_risk_score_real,
  breaks = p_terciles,
  labels = c("T1_LowRisk", "T2_MedRisk", "T3_HighRisk"),
  include.lowest = TRUE
)

df_surv$Grupo_KM <- factor(df_surv$Grupo_KM, levels = c("T1_LowRisk", "T2_MedRisk", "T3_HighRisk"))

cat("\n=================================================================\n")
cat("--- SAMPLE DISTRIBUTION ACROSS RISK TERTILES ---\n")
print(table(df_surv$Grupo_KM))
cat("=================================================================\n\n")

## =============================================================================
## 2. KAPLAN-MEIER ANALYSIS (SINGLE DISPLAY AND EXPORT)
## =============================================================================

surv_obj <- Surv(time = df_surv$TTS, event = df_surv$event)
fit_km_terc <- survfit(surv_obj ~ Grupo_KM, data = df_surv)

# Color palette: blue (T1, low risk/protected), orange (T2, intermediate risk), red (T3, high risk)
colores_3 <- c("#2166AC", "#EF8A62", "#B2182B")

p_km_terc <- ggsurvplot(
  fit_km_terc,
  data = df_surv,
  pval = "Log-rank p = 1.72 × 10⁻²⁴",
  pval.size = 5,
  pval.coord = c(50, 0.15),

  # Color palette and legend settings
  palette = colores_3,
  legend = "right",
  legend.title = "Risk Score",
  legend.labs = c("T1: Low Risk / Protected", "T2: Medium Risk", "T3: High Risk"),

  # Adjusted risk table
  risk.table = TRUE,
  risk.table.height = 0.26,
  risk.table.y.text = FALSE,
  risk.table.col = "strata",
  fontsize = 4.0,

  # Plot title and axis labels
  title = "Time to HIV Seroconversion by Elastic Net Risk Score",
  xlab = "Time to Seroconversion (Days / TTS)",
  ylab = "Probability of Remaining HIV-Free",
  ggtheme = theme_bw(base_size = 12)
)

# Display the Kaplan-Meier plot once
print(p_km_terc)

# Export publication-quality figures
pdf("km_seroconversion_clean.pdf", width = 9.5, height = 6.5)
print(p_km_terc)
dev.off()

png("km_seroconversion_clean_600dpi.png", width = 9.5, height = 6.5, units = "in", res = 600)
print(p_km_terc)
dev.off()

## =============================================================================
## 3. MULTIVARIABLE COX MODEL (REFERENCE CATEGORY: T3_HighRisk)
## =============================================================================

# Set T3_HighRisk as the reference category to address the zero-event separation issue
df_surv$Grupo_Cox_T3ref <- relevel(df_surv$Grupo_KM, ref = "T3_HighRisk")

cox_terc <- coxph(surv_obj ~ Grupo_Cox_T3ref + age + risk, data = df_surv)

cat("\n=================================================================\n")
cat("--- COX PROPORTIONAL HAZARDS MODEL (REFERENCE: T3_HighRisk) ---\n")
cat("=================================================================\n")
print(summary(cox_terc))

## =============================================================================
## 4. CUSTOM COX FOREST PLOT (GGPLOT2)
## =============================================================================

res_cox <- tidy(cox_terc, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE)

# Explicit reference row for the T3 group
ref_row <- data.frame(
  term = "Grupo_Cox_T3refT3_HighRisk",
  estimate = 1.00,
  std.error = NA,
  statistic = NA,
  p.value = NA,
  conf.low = 1.00,
  conf.high = 1.00
)

plot_df <- bind_rows(ref_row, res_cox) %>%
  mutate(
    Label = case_when(
      term == "Grupo_Cox_T3refT3_HighRisk" ~ "T3: High Risk",
      term == "Grupo_Cox_T3refT2_MedRisk"  ~ "T2: Medium Risk",
      term == "Grupo_Cox_T3refT1_LowRisk"  ~ "T1: Low Risk / Protected",
      term == "age"                         ~ "Age (Years)",
      term == "risklow"                     ~ "Behavioral Risk (Low vs High)",
      TRUE ~ term
    ),

    # Adjust values for visualization on the logarithmic scale
    estimate_plot = ifelse(estimate < 0.001, 0.0001, estimate),
    conf.low_plot = ifelse(is.na(conf.low) | conf.low < 0.0001, 0.00001, conf.low),
    conf.high_plot = ifelse(is.na(conf.high) | is.infinite(conf.high) | conf.high > 10, 10, conf.high),

    HR_Text = case_when(
      term == "Grupo_Cox_T3refT3_HighRisk" ~ "1.00 (Reference)",
      estimate < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001 (0 events)",
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.2f (%.2f - %.2f)", estimate, conf.low, conf.high)
    ),
    p_Text = case_when(
      is.na(p.value) ~ "-",
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "< 0.001 ***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ sprintf("%.3f **", p.value),
      p.value < 0.05  ~ sprintf("%.3f *", p.value),
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p.value)
    )
  )

plot_df$Label <- factor(plot_df$Label, levels = rev(plot_df$Label))

p_forest_custom <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = estimate_plot, y = Label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1.0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = conf.low_plot, xmax = conf.high_plot),
    height = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.8,
    color = "#2C3E50"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, color = "#B2182B") +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 5.0),
    labels = c("<0.0001", "0.001", "0.01", "0.10", "1.00", "5.00"),
    limits = c(0.00001, 10.0)
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = 8.0, label = paste0("HR: ", HR_Text, "  |  p = ", p_Text)),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Multivariable Cox Model (Reference: T3 High Risk)",
    # Include the log-rank p-value in the subtitle
    subtitle = expression("HIV Seroconversion Risk by Elastic Net Score Tertiles | Log-rank " ~ p == 1.72 %*% 10^-24),
    x = "Hazard Ratio (95% CI, Log Scale)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.00001, 30.0)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "grey30", face = "italic"),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 20, b = 10, l = 10)
  )

# Display the forest plot
print(p_forest_custom)

# Export the forest plot
ggsave("forest_plot_cox_terciles_custom.pdf", plot = p_forest_custom, width = 10, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave("forest_plot_cox_terciles_custom_600dpi.png", plot = p_forest_custom, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 600)
```

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

## =============================================================================
## 1. VERIFY AND COMPUTE THE ELASTIC NET SCORE IF NOT ALREADY AVAILABLE
## =============================================================================
if (!"en_score" %in% colnames(df_surv) || is.null(df_surv$en_score) || all(is.na(df_surv$en_score))) {
  cat("--> 'en_score' not found in df_surv. Computing scores from the expression matrix...\n")
  
  mat_exp <- if (exists("logCPM_global")) logCPM_global else vst_mat
  
  # Identify the sample identifier column (row names or sampleID)
  sample_ids <- if ("sampleID" %in% colnames(df_surv)) df_surv$sampleID else rownames(df_surv)
  
  df_boot <- as.data.frame(pipeline_attrition_summary)
  
  # Ensure column compatibility in the fallback procedure
  if ("Folds_Selected_EN" %in% colnames(df_boot)) {
    max_folds <- max(df_boot$Folds_Selected_EN, na.rm = TRUE)
    df_boot$freq_prop <- df_boot$Folds_Selected_EN / max_folds
    weights_df <- df_boot %>% filter(freq_prop >= 0.40)
  } else {
    weights_df <- df_boot %>% filter(Porcentaje_Estabilidad >= 40)
  }
  
  col_beta <- grep("Beta|coef", colnames(weights_df), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
  col_gene <- grep("Feature|Gene", colnames(weights_df), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
  
  weights_df <- weights_df %>%
    dplyr::select(Feature = all_of(col_gene), Mean_Beta_Conditional = all_of(col_beta)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Mean_Beta_Conditional) & Mean_Beta_Conditional != 0)
  
  genes_comunes <- intersect(weights_df$Feature, rownames(mat_exp))
  samples_comunes <- intersect(sample_ids, colnames(mat_exp))
  
  weights_df <- weights_df %>% filter(Feature %in% genes_comunes)
  
  sub_mat <- mat_exp[weights_df$Feature, samples_comunes, drop = FALSE]
  beta_vec <- weights_df$Mean_Beta_Conditional[match(rownames(sub_mat), weights_df$Feature)]
  
  en_scores <- as.numeric(t(sub_mat) %*% beta_vec)
  names(en_scores) <- colnames(sub_mat)
  
  # Assign scores to df_surv while preserving sample order
  if ("sampleID" %in% colnames(df_surv)) {
    df_surv$en_score <- en_scores[df_surv$sampleID]
  } else {
    df_surv$en_score <- en_scores[rownames(df_surv)]
  }
}

## =============================================================================
## 2. PREPARE THE CONTINUOUS SEROCONVERSION RISK SCORE (Z-SCORE)
## =============================================================================

# Reverse the score direction so that higher values indicate greater seroconversion risk
df_surv$en_risk_score_real <- -1 * df_surv$en_score

# Standardize the risk score (mean = 0, standard deviation = 1)
df_surv$en_score_z <- as.numeric(scale(df_surv$en_risk_score_real))

surv_obj <- Surv(time = df_surv$TTS, event = df_surv$event)

## =============================================================================
## 3. MULTIVARIABLE COX MODEL WITH A CONTINUOUS SCORE (PRIMARY INFERENCE)
## =============================================================================
cox_score_cont <- coxph(
  surv_obj ~ en_score_z + age + risk,
  data = df_surv
)

cat("\n=================================================================\n")
cat("--- CONTINUOUS COX MODEL: HAZARD RATIO PER 1-SD INCREASE IN RISK SCORE ---\n")
cat("=================================================================\n")
print(summary(cox_score_cont))

## =============================================================================
## 4. PROPORTIONAL HAZARDS ASSUMPTION (cox.zph)
## =============================================================================
ph_test_cont <- cox.zph(cox_score_cont)

cat("\n=================================================================\n")
cat("--- PROPORTIONAL HAZARDS DIAGNOSTICS (cox.zph) FOR THE CONTINUOUS SCORE ---\n")
cat("=================================================================\n")
print(ph_test_cont)

# Plot Schoenfeld residuals for the continuous risk score
p_zph_cont <- ggcoxzph(ph_test_cont, var = "en_score_z")
print(p_zph_cont)

# Export the Schoenfeld residual plot using a direct PDF graphics device
pdf("schoenfeld_residuals_continuous_score.pdf", width = 8, height = 5)
print(p_zph_cont)
dev.off()

## =============================================================================
## 5. INCREMENTAL DISCRIMINATIVE PERFORMANCE (C-INDEX)
## =============================================================================
cox_clin <- coxph(surv_obj ~ age + risk, data = df_surv)

c_clin <- concordance(cox_clin)$concordance
c_cont <- concordance(cox_score_cont)$concordance

cat("\n=================================================================\n")
cat(sprintf("* Clinical model C-index (Age + Risk)              : %.3f\n", c_clin))
cat(sprintf("* Continuous-score model C-index (+1 SD Z-score)   : %.3f\n", c_cont))
cat(sprintf("* Incremental discrimination (Delta C-index)       : +%.3f (%.1f%% improvement)\n",
            c_cont - c_clin, ((c_cont - c_clin)/c_clin)*100))
cat("=================================================================\n\n")
```

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

## =============================================================================
## 1. DATA PREPARATION AND MODEL FITTING
## =============================================================================
vars_modelo <- c("TTS", "event", "age", "risk", "en_score_z")
df_surv_clean <- df_surv[complete.cases(df_surv[, vars_modelo]), ]

cat("--> Total samples included in the complete-case analysis:", nrow(df_surv_clean), "\n\n")

# A) Baseline clinical model
cox_clin <- coxph(
  Surv(TTS, event) ~ age + risk,
  data = df_surv_clean
)

# B) Full Cox model with a time-varying coefficient
cox_score_tv <- coxph(
  Surv(TTS, event) ~ en_score_z + age + risk + tt(en_score_z),
  data = df_surv_clean,
  tt = function(x, t, ...) x * log(t + 1)
)

cat("=================================================================\n")
cat("--- COX MODEL WITH A TIME-VARYING COEFFICIENT tt() ---\n")
cat("=================================================================\n")
print(summary(cox_score_tv))

## =============================================================================
## 2. LIKELIHOOD RATIO TEST (LRT)
## =============================================================================
ll_clin <- logLik(cox_clin)
ll_tv   <- logLik(cox_score_tv)

lrt_stat  <- 2 * (as.numeric(ll_tv) - as.numeric(ll_clin))
df_diff   <- attr(ll_tv, "df") - attr(ll_clin, "df")
p_val_lrt <- pchisq(lrt_stat, df = df_diff, lower.tail = FALSE)

tabla_lrt <- data.frame(
  Modelo   = c("1: Baseline Clinical (age + risk)", "2: Full Time-Varying (age + risk + score + tt)"),
  LogLik   = round(c(as.numeric(ll_clin), as.numeric(ll_tv)), 2),
  Df_Model = c(attr(ll_clin, "df"), attr(ll_tv, "df")),
  Chisq    = c(NA, round(lrt_stat, 2)),
  Df_Diff  = c(NA, df_diff),
  p_value  = c(NA, format.pval(p_val_lrt, digits = 3, eps = 0.001))
)

cat("\n=================================================================\n")
cat("--- MODEL COMPARISON: BASELINE CLINICAL vs. FULL TIME-VARYING MODEL (LRT) ---\n")
cat("=================================================================\n")
print(tabla_lrt)

## =============================================================================
## 3. INCREMENTAL DISCRIMINATION (C-INDEX - POSITIONAL EXTRACTION)
## =============================================================================

# Extract the C-index from position [1] and its SE from position [2]
sum_clin <- summary(cox_clin)
sum_tv   <- summary(cox_score_tv)

c_clin  <- unname(sum_clin$concordance[1])
se_clin <- unname(sum_clin$concordance[2])

c_tv  <- unname(sum_tv$concordance[1])
se_tv <- unname(sum_tv$concordance[2])

delta_c <- c_tv - c_clin
pct_inc <- (delta_c / c_clin) * 100

cat("\n=================================================================\n")
cat(sprintf("* Baseline clinical model C-index (Age + Risk)       : %.3f (SE: %.3f)\n", c_clin, se_clin))
cat(sprintf("* Full time-varying model C-index (Score + tt)       : %.3f (SE: %.3f)\n", c_tv, se_tv))
cat(sprintf("* Absolute discrimination gain (Delta C-index)      : +%.3f (%.1f%% increase)\n", delta_c, pct_inc))
cat("=================================================================\n\n")

## =============================================================================
## 4. CONTINUOUS HR(t) ESTIMATION AND SELECTED FOLLOW-UP TIME POINTS
## =============================================================================
coef_names <- names(coef(cox_score_tv))
var_main_name <- coef_names[grep("^en_score_z$", coef_names)]
var_tt_name   <- coef_names[grep("tt\\(", coef_names)]

beta_main <- coef(cox_score_tv)[var_main_name]
beta_tt   <- coef(cox_score_tv)[var_tt_name]

vcov_mat  <- vcov(cox_score_tv)
var_main  <- vcov_mat[var_main_name, var_main_name]
var_tt    <- vcov_mat[var_tt_name, var_tt_name]
cov_both  <- vcov_mat[var_main_name, var_tt_name]

# Define a continuous follow-up time grid
max_dias <- max(df_surv_clean$TTS, na.rm = TRUE)
dias_grid <- seq(1, max_dias, length.out = 300)

df_grid <- data.frame(Time_Days = dias_grid) %>%
  mutate(
    log_t = log(Time_Days + 1),
    log_HR = beta_main + beta_tt * log_t,
    SE_log_HR = sqrt(var_main + (log_t^2) * var_tt + 2 * log_t * cov_both),
    HR = exp(log_HR),
    HR_low = exp(log_HR - 1.96 * SE_log_HR),
    HR_high = exp(log_HR + 1.96 * SE_log_HR)
  )

# Define selected follow-up time points
dias_target <- c(90, 180, 365, 730, 1095)
dias_target <- dias_target[dias_target <= max_dias]

res_hr_time <- data.frame(Time_Days = dias_target) %>%
  mutate(
    log_t = log(Time_Days + 1),
    log_HR = beta_main + beta_tt * log_t,
    SE_log_HR = sqrt(var_main + (log_t^2) * var_tt + 2 * log_t * cov_both),
    HR = exp(log_HR),
    HR_low = exp(log_HR - 1.96 * SE_log_HR),
    HR_high = exp(log_HR + 1.96 * SE_log_HR)
  )

cat("=================================================================\n")
cat("--- TIME-VARYING HR(t) ESTIMATES AT SELECTED FOLLOW-UP TIME POINTS ---\n")
cat("=================================================================\n")
print(res_hr_time %>% select(Time_Days, HR, HR_low, HR_high))

## =============================================================================
## 5. PUBLICATION-QUALITY FIGURE WITH GGPREPEL
## =============================================================================
p_hr_time <- ggplot() +

  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6) +

  geom_ribbon(
    data = df_grid,
    aes(x = Time_Days, ymin = HR_low, ymax = HR_high),
    fill = "#2166AC", alpha = 0.18
  ) +

  geom_line(
    data = df_grid,
    aes(x = Time_Days, y = HR),
    color = "#2166AC", linewidth = 1.2
  ) +

  geom_point(
    data = res_hr_time,
    aes(x = Time_Days, y = HR),
    color = "#B2182B", size = 3.5
  ) +

  geom_text_repel(
    data = res_hr_time,
    aes(x = Time_Days, y = HR, label = sprintf("%.2f\n(%.2f-%.2f)", HR, HR_low, HR_high)),
    nudge_y = 4,
    direction = "y",
    point.padding = 0.5,
    segment.color = "grey60",
    segment.size = 0.3,
    size = 3.3,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black"
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, dias_target), limits = c(0, max_dias + 50)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(df_grid$HR_high) * 1.15), clip = "off") +

  labs(
    title = "Time-Varying Hazard Ratio for Elastic Net Score (+1 SD)",
    subtitle = sprintf("Prognostic impact amplifies over time | LRT vs. Clinical Model: p = %s", format.pval(p_val_lrt, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)),
    x = "Follow-up Time (Days / TTS)",
    y = "Hazard Ratio (95% CI) per +1 SD Increase"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey30"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 20, b = 10, l = 10)
  )

print(p_hr_time)

# Export publication-quality figures
ggsave("time_varying_hr_elastic_net.pdf", plot = p_hr_time, width = 9, height = 5.5, device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave("time_varying_hr_elastic_net_600dpi.png", plot = p_hr_time, width = 9, height = 5.5, dpi = 600)
```



```{r}
## =============================================================================
## FINAL BENCHMARK — ORIGINAL MODEL
##
## A) FINAL/APPARENT SCORE:
##    Kaplan-Meier analysis by tertiles + log-rank test
##
## B) OUT-OF-FOLD SCORE:
##    Adjusted time-varying Cox model + HR(t)
## =============================================================================

library(survival)
library(dplyr)

## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 1. EVENT DISTRIBUTION BY RISK TERTILE
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n=================================================================\n")
cat("--- EVENT DISTRIBUTION BY RISK TERTILE ---\n")
cat("=================================================================\n")

tab_eventos <- table(
  Tercile = df_surv$Grupo_KM,
  Event = df_surv$event
)

print(tab_eventos)

cat("\nNumber of events by tertile:\n")
print(
  df_surv %>%
    group_by(Grupo_KM) %>%
    summarise(
      N = n(),
      Events = sum(event == 1),
      Censored = sum(event == 0),
      Event_rate = mean(event == 1),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
)

## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 2. RECALCULATED LOG-RANK TEST
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------

surv_obj <- Surv(
  time  = df_surv$TTS,
  event = df_surv$event
)

logrank_test <- survdiff(
  surv_obj ~ Grupo_KM,
  data = df_surv
)

logrank_df <- length(logrank_test$n) - 1

logrank_p <- pchisq(
  logrank_test$chisq,
  df = logrank_df,
  lower.tail = FALSE
)

cat("\n=================================================================\n")
cat("--- LOG-RANK TEST ---\n")
cat("=================================================================\n")

print(logrank_test)

cat(
  "\nChi-square =",
  round(logrank_test$chisq, 4),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "df =",
  logrank_df,
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "p =",
  format.pval(
    logrank_p,
    digits = 6,
    eps = 1e-300
  ),
  "\n"
)


## Reconstruct survival dataset using OOF predictions
pred_file <- file.path(base_dir, "Predictive_model_GENES_ONLY_predictions.tsv")
if (!file.exists(pred_file)) stop("ERROR: OOF prediction file not found: ", pred_file)

pred_oof <- read.delim(pred_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
required_pred <- c("Sample", "y_bin", "pred_lambda_1se")
stopifnot(all(required_pred %in% names(pred_oof)))
stopifnot(all(c("sampleID", "TTS", "event", "age", "risk") %in% names(df_surv)))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(pred_oof$Sample), !anyDuplicated(df_surv$sampleID))

df_surv_oof <- df_surv %>%
  select(-any_of(c("en_score_oof", "en_risk_score", "en_score_z"))) %>%
  left_join(pred_oof %>% transmute(sampleID = Sample, en_score_oof = pred_lambda_1se), by = "sampleID") %>%
  mutate(en_risk_score = 1 - en_score_oof)

stopifnot(!anyNA(df_surv_oof$en_risk_score))
df_surv_oof$en_score_z <- as.numeric(scale(df_surv_oof$en_risk_score))
stopifnot(is.finite(sd(df_surv_oof$en_score_z)), sd(df_surv_oof$en_score_z) > 0)

cat("OOF scores matched:", sum(!is.na(df_surv_oof$en_score_oof)), "of", nrow(df_surv_oof), "\n")


## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 3. TIME-VARYING COX MODEL USING OOF SCORES
##
## IMPORTANT:
## Here, 'en_score_z' must be EXACTLY the standardized OOF score
## used in the preceding survival analysis.
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------

stopifnot(
  nrow(df_surv_oof) == 104,
  !anyNA(df_surv_oof$en_score_oof),
  !anyNA(df_surv_oof$en_score_z)
)

cat(
  "\nCorrelation between OOF risk score and OOF HESN prediction:",
  cor(df_surv_oof$en_risk_score, df_surv_oof$en_score_oof),
  "\n"
)

df_surv_clean <- df_surv_oof %>%
  filter(
    complete.cases(
      TTS,
      event,
      en_score_z,
      age,
      risk
    )
  )

cox_tv_oof <- coxph(
  Surv(TTS, event) ~
    en_score_z +
    age +
    risk +
    tt(en_score_z),
  data = df_surv_clean,
  tt = function(x, t, ...) {
    x * log(t + 1)
  }
)

cat("\n=================================================================\n")
cat("--- TIME-VARYING COX MODEL WITH OOF SCORES ---\n")
cat("=================================================================\n")

print(summary(cox_tv_oof))

## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 4. EXTRACT SCORE COEFFICIENTS
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------

beta_score <- coef(cox_tv_oof)["en_score_z"]
beta_time  <- coef(cox_tv_oof)["tt(en_score_z)"]

V <- vcov(cox_tv_oof)

cat("\nBaseline score coefficient =", beta_score, "\n")
cat("Score coefficient × log(t+1) =", beta_time, "\n")

## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 5. TIME-VARYING HR(t) PER 1-SD INCREASE IN OOF RISK SCORE
##
## log HR(t) =
## beta_score + beta_time * log(t + 1)
##
## The variance accounts for covariance between both coefficients.
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------

times_eval <- c(
  30,
  90,
  180,
  365,
  730,
  1095
)

hr_time <- lapply(times_eval, function(t) {

  L <- log(t + 1)

  logHR <- beta_score + beta_time * L

  var_logHR <-
    V["en_score_z", "en_score_z"] +
    (L^2) * V["tt(en_score_z)", "tt(en_score_z)"] +
    2 * L * V["en_score_z", "tt(en_score_z)"]

  se_logHR <- sqrt(var_logHR)

  data.frame(
    Time_days = t,
    HR = exp(logHR),
    Lower_95CI = exp(logHR - 1.96 * se_logHR),
    Upper_95CI = exp(logHR + 1.96 * se_logHR)
  )
})

hr_time <- bind_rows(hr_time)

## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 6. DISPLAY TIME-VARYING HR(t) ESTIMATES
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n=================================================================\n")
cat("--- TIME-VARYING HR(t) PER 1-SD INCREASE IN OOF RISK SCORE ---\n")
cat("=================================================================\n")

print(
  hr_time %>%
    mutate(
      HR = round(HR, 3),
      Lower_95CI = round(Lower_95CI, 3),
      Upper_95CI = round(Upper_95CI, 3)
    ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 7. ESTIMATE THE TIME AT WHICH HR(t) = 1
##
## beta_score + beta_time*log(t+1) = 0
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------


## Check whether the time-varying HR crosses 1 within follow-up
t_cross <- if (is.finite(beta_time) && abs(beta_time) > 1e-10) exp(-beta_score / beta_time) - 1 else NA_real_
max_followup <- max(df_surv_clean$TTS, na.rm = TRUE)

if (is.finite(t_cross) && t_cross >= 0 && t_cross <= max_followup) {
  cat("HR(t) = 1 at approximately day:", round(t_cross, 1), "\n")
} else {
  cat("No HR(t) = 1 crossing identified within the observed follow-up.\n")
}


cat("\nHR(t) crosses HR = 1 at approximately day:",
    round(t_cross, 1), "\n")

## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 8. EXPORT RESULTS
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------

write.table(
  hr_time,
  file = "Original_Model_OOF_TimeVarying_HR.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.table(
  as.data.frame.matrix(tab_eventos),
  file = "Original_Model_Events_by_Tertile.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE
)

cat("\nResults successfully exported.\n")

# Define OOF risk score tertiles
q_oof <- quantile(
  df_surv_oof$en_risk_score,
  probs = c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

df_surv_oof$Grupo_KM_OOF <- cut(
  df_surv_oof$en_risk_score,
  breaks = q_oof,
  labels = c("T1_LowRisk", "T2_MedRisk", "T3_HighRisk"),
  include.lowest = TRUE
)

# Display event distribution across OOF risk tertiles
table(
  df_surv_oof$Grupo_KM_OOF,
  df_surv_oof$event
)

# Construct the survival object for OOF analysis
surv_obj_oof <- Surv(
  df_surv_oof$TTS,
  df_surv_oof$event
)

# Perform the log-rank test using OOF risk tertiles
logrank_oof <- survdiff(
  surv_obj_oof ~ Grupo_KM_OOF,
  data = df_surv_oof
)

p_logrank_oof <- pchisq(
  logrank_oof$chisq,
  df = length(logrank_oof$n) - 1,
  lower.tail = FALSE
)

# Display OOF log-rank test results
logrank_oof
p_logrank_oof

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

# 1. Load metadata and expression data using base R to avoid readr parsing issues
metadata <- read.csv("GSE165132_metadata.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
log2_counts <- read.csv("GSE165132_CPM_TMM_log2_gene_counts_matrix.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

# Remove leading/trailing whitespace from column names
colnames(metadata) <- trimws(colnames(metadata))
colnames(log2_counts) <- trimws(colnames(log2_counts))

# 2. Prepare sample metadata
col_data <- metadata %>%
  filter(!is.na(group), group != "", !is.na(subjectID)) %>%
  mutate(condition = group) %>%
  distinct(subjectID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "subjectID")

# 3. Identify samples shared between the expression matrix and metadata
muestras_comunes <- intersect(rownames(col_data), colnames(log2_counts))

# 4. Prepare the global expression matrix (rows = samples, columns = genes)
X_global <- log2_counts %>%
  filter(!is.na(symbol), symbol != "") %>%
  distinct(symbol, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(symbol, all_of(muestras_comunes)) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "symbol") %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  t()

# 5. Reorder metadata to ensure exact sample alignment
col_data <- col_data[rownames(X_global), , drop = FALSE]

# 6. Define the output directory
base_dir <- "./resultados_elastic_net"
if (!dir.exists(base_dir)) dir.create(base_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# Final validation of sample alignment
stopifnot(identical(rownames(X_global), rownames(col_data)))
cat("Sample alignment verified! Samples:", nrow(X_global), "| Genes:", ncol(X_global), "\n")
```
