```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(glmnet)
library(pROC)

# ==============================================================================
# A. LOAD AND PREPARE THE INDEPENDENT GEO DATASET
# ==============================================================================

metadata <- read.csv("GSE165132_metadata.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
log2_counts <- read.csv("GSE165132_CPM_TMM_log2_gene_counts_matrix.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

colnames(metadata) <- trimws(colnames(metadata))
colnames(log2_counts) <- trimws(colnames(log2_counts))

# Prepare sample metadata for the external dataset
col_data_nuevos <- metadata %>%
  filter(!is.na(group), group != "", !is.na(subjectID)) %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(group, levels = c("HIV", "HESN"))) %>%
  distinct(subjectID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "subjectID")

# Prepare the external expression matrix (rows = samples, columns = genes)
muestras_comunes <- intersect(rownames(col_data_nuevos), colnames(log2_counts))

X_nuevos <- log2_counts %>%
  filter(!is.na(symbol), symbol != "") %>%
  distinct(symbol, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(symbol, all_of(muestras_comunes)) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "symbol") %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  t()

col_data_nuevos <- col_data_nuevos[rownames(X_nuevos), , drop = FALSE]

# ==============================================================================
# B. LOAD AND EVALUATE THE PREVIOUSLY TRAINED MODEL
# ==============================================================================

# 1. Load the trained model bundle (adjust the path if necessary)
model_bundle <- readRDS("Clasificador_Final_ElasticNet_PBMC_bundle.rds")

# 2. Verify the availability of all required model input genes
genes_requeridos <- model_bundle$genes_input
genes_faltantes <- setdiff(genes_requeridos, colnames(X_nuevos))

if (length(genes_faltantes) > 0) {
  warning("Warning: The following genes required by the model are missing from the external dataset:\n",
          paste(genes_faltantes, collapse = ", "))
} else {
  cat("All genes required by the model are present in the external dataset!\n")
}

# 3. Construct an input matrix with the exact gene order required by the model
# Missing genes are assigned zero values to preserve compatibility with predict()
X_eval <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(X_nuevos), ncol = length(genes_requeridos),
                 dimnames = list(rownames(X_nuevos), genes_requeridos))

genes_presentes <- intersect(genes_requeridos, colnames(X_nuevos))
X_eval[, genes_presentes] <- X_nuevos[, genes_presentes]

# 4. Predict probabilities for the positive class (HESN)
prob_nuevas <- predict(
  model_bundle$model,
  newx = X_eval,
  s = model_bundle$lambda,
  type = "response"
)

# 5. Assign predicted classes using the training-derived Youden threshold
pred_clase <- ifelse(prob_nuevas >= model_bundle$apparent_youden_threshold,
                     model_bundle$positive_class,
                     model_bundle$negative_class)

# 6. Evaluate discrimination using ROC analysis and AUC
y_true <- ifelse(col_data_nuevos$condition == model_bundle$positive_class, 1, 0)

roc_externo <- pROC::roc(
  response = y_true,
  predictor = as.numeric(prob_nuevas),
  levels = c(0, 1),
  direction = "<"
)

auc_val <- pROC::auc(roc_externo)
ci_val <- pROC::ci.auc(roc_externo)

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("EXTERNAL VALIDATION RESULTS\n")
cat("============================================================\n")
cat("Evaluated samples:", nrow(X_eval), "\n")
cat("External dataset AUC:", round(auc_val, 3), "\n")
cat("95% AUC CI:", round(ci_val[1], 3), "-", round(ci_val[3], 3), "\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

# Plot the external validation ROC curve
plot(roc_externo,
     legacy.axes = TRUE,
     lwd = 3,
     main = paste("External Validation — GSE165132\nAUC =", round(auc_val, 3)))
abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "gray")

```


## Transportable Elastic Net Classifier — GSE165132

```{r}
############################################################
## TRANSPORTABLE ELASTIC NET MODEL FOR GSE165132
##
## TRAINING COHORT:
##   Original PBMC cohort stored in the 'dds' object
##
## EXTERNAL COHORT:
##   GSE165132_CPM_TMM_log2_gene_counts_matrix.csv
##   GSE165132_metadata.csv
##
## OBJECTIVES:
## 1) Define the technically available gene universe in GSE165132
##    WITHOUT using its HIV/HESN labels.
## 2) Repeat internal 5-fold CV restricted to transportable genes.
## 3) Train the final transportable model using the ENTIRE PBMC cohort.
## 4) Freeze the model.
## 5) Only then read the external outcome and evaluate GSE165132.
############################################################


# ============================================================
# 0. LIBRARIES
# ============================================================

library(glmnet)
library(pROC)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(DESeq2)
library(edgeR)
library(caret)


# ============================================================
# 1. EXTERNAL FILES
# ============================================================

external_expression_file <-
  "GSE165132_CPM_TMM_log2_gene_counts_matrix.csv"

external_metadata_file <-
  "GSE165132_metadata.csv"


stopifnot(
  file.exists(external_expression_file),
  file.exists(external_metadata_file)
)

cat("External files successfully located.\n")


# ============================================================
# 2. DEFINE THE GENE UNIVERSE AVAILABLE IN GSE165132
#
# IMPORTANT:
# External HIV/HESN labels are NOT used here.
# Only technical gene availability is assessed.
# ============================================================

external_expression_header <- read.csv(
  external_expression_file,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

colnames(external_expression_header) <-
  trimws(colnames(external_expression_header))

if (!"symbol" %in% colnames(external_expression_header)) {
  stop("ERROR: Column not found: 'symbol' in GSE165132.")
}


genes_externos <- external_expression_header$symbol

genes_externos <- trimws(genes_externos)

genes_externos <- unique(
  genes_externos[
    !is.na(genes_externos) &
      genes_externos != ""
  ]
)


cat(
  "Unique genes available in GSE165132:",
  length(genes_externos),
  "\n"
)


# ============================================================
# 3. RETRIEVE THE ORIGINAL PBMC COHORT FROM dds
#
# Do not use the col_data object from the environment, as it may have
# been overwritten by external metadata.
# ============================================================

if (!exists("dds")) {
  stop("ERROR: The original PBMC 'dds' object must be loaded.")
}


mat_raw <- counts(dds)

col_data_train <- as.data.frame(
  colData(dds)
)


cat("\n=============================================\n")
cat("ORIGINAL PBMC COHORT\n")
cat("=============================================\n")

cat(
  "Samples in count matrix:",
  ncol(mat_raw),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Samples in metadata:",
  nrow(col_data_train),
  "\n"
)


# Verify that both objects contain the same samples

if (!setequal(
  colnames(mat_raw),
  rownames(col_data_train)
)) {

  stop(
    "ERROR: The dds counts and colData do not contain the same samples."
  )
}


# Reorder metadata to match the count matrix exactly

col_data_train <- col_data_train[
  colnames(mat_raw),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]


stopifnot(
  identical(
    colnames(mat_raw),
    rownames(col_data_train)
  )
)


cat(
  "OK: PBMC counts and metadata are perfectly aligned.\n"
)


# Check the condition variable

if (!"condition" %in% colnames(col_data_train)) {
  stop("ERROR: col_data_train does not contain the 'condition' variable.")
}


# Outcome:
# HIV = 0
# HESN = 1

y <- factor(
  col_data_train$condition,
  levels = c("HIV", "HESN")
)

y_bin <- unname(
  ifelse(
    y == "HESN",
    1,
    0
  )
)


cat("\nPBMC outcome distribution:\n")
print(table(y))


# ============================================================
# 4. CREATE 5 FOLDS FOR OUTER/OOF CROSS-VALIDATION
# ============================================================

set.seed(123)

folds <- caret::createFolds(
  y,
  k = 5,
  list = TRUE
)


all_preds_transport <- rep(
  NA_real_,
  length(y_bin)
)


# Track DESeq2 candidate genes available in each fold

deseq_history_transport <- data.frame(
  Fold = character(),
  Gene = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


# Track genes actually selected by Elastic Net

genes_history_transport <- data.frame(
  Fold = character(),
  Gene = character(),
  Beta = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


# Record whether fallback selection (Plan B) was required

used_planB_transport <- rep(
  FALSE,
  length(folds)
)


# ============================================================
# 5. LEAKAGE-CONTROLLED CROSS-VALIDATION
# ============================================================

for (i in seq_along(folds)) {

  cat("\n============================================================\n")
  cat("FOLD", i, "of", length(folds), "\n")
  cat("============================================================\n")


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 5A. TRAIN / TEST
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  test_idx <- folds[[i]]

  train_idx <- setdiff(
    seq_along(y_bin),
    test_idx
  )


  X_raw_tr <- mat_raw[
    ,
    train_idx,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  X_raw_te <- mat_raw[
    ,
    test_idx,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  meta_tr <- col_data_train[
    train_idx,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  Y_tr <- y_bin[
    train_idx
  ]


  stopifnot(
    identical(
      colnames(X_raw_tr),
      rownames(meta_tr)
    )
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 5B. DESeq2 FITTED EXCLUSIVELY ON TRAINING DATA
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  dds_tr <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = round(X_raw_tr),
    colData = meta_tr,
    design = ~ condition
  )


  # same filter as in the original pipeline

  keep <- rowSums(
    counts(dds_tr) >= 10
  ) >= 5


  dds_tr <- dds_tr[
    keep,
  ]


  dds_tr <- DESeq(
    dds_tr,
    quiet = TRUE
  )


  res_tr <- results(
    dds_tr,
    contrast = c(
      "condition",
      "HESN",
      "HIV"
    )
  )


  res_tr_df <- as.data.frame(
    res_tr
  ) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(padj)
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 5C. WITHIN-FOLD BIOLOGICAL FEATURE SELECTION
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  sig_bio_fold <- res_tr_df %>%
    filter(
      padj < 0.05,
      abs(log2FoldChange) > 0.5
    )


  genes_ml_fold <- sig_bio_fold$gene


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # PLAN B conceptually identical to the original pipeline
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (length(genes_ml_fold) < 5) {

    used_planB_transport[i] <- TRUE

    genes_ml_fold <- res_tr_df %>%
      filter(
        !is.na(pvalue)
      ) %>%
      arrange(
        pvalue
      ) %>%
      slice_head(
        n = 100
      ) %>%
      pull(
        gene
      )
  }


  cat(
    "Candidate genes before external availability restriction:",
    length(genes_ml_fold),
    "\n"
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 5D. TRANSPORTABILITY RESTRICTION
  #
  # Only genes available in GSE165132 are permitted.
  # External clinical labels are not used here.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  genes_ml_fold <- intersect(
    genes_ml_fold,
    genes_externos
  )


  # safety check: genes must also exist in PBMC training and test sets

  genes_ml_fold <- intersect(
    genes_ml_fold,
    rownames(X_raw_tr)
  )

  genes_ml_fold <- intersect(
    genes_ml_fold,
    rownames(X_raw_te)
  )


  cat(
    "Transportable candidate genes:",
    length(genes_ml_fold),
    "\n"
  )


  if (length(genes_ml_fold) < 2) {

    stop(
      paste0(
        "ERROR: Fold ",
        i,
        " has fewer than 2 transportable genes."
      )
    )
  }


  deseq_history_transport <- bind_rows(
    deseq_history_transport,
    data.frame(
      Fold = paste0(
        "Fold_",
        i
      ),
      Gene = genes_ml_fold,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 5E. TMM + logCPM
  #
  # As in the original pipeline.
  # Each fold is normalized separately.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  base_genes <- rownames(
    dds_tr
  )


  dge_tr <- DGEList(
    counts = X_raw_tr[
      base_genes,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  )


  dge_tr <- calcNormFactors(
    dge_tr,
    method = "TMM"
  )


  logCPM_tr <- cpm(
    dge_tr,
    log = TRUE,
    prior.count = 1
  )


  dge_te <- DGEList(
    counts = X_raw_te[
      base_genes,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  )


  dge_te <- calcNormFactors(
    dge_te,
    method = "TMM"
  )


  logCPM_te <- cpm(
    dge_te,
    log = TRUE,
    prior.count = 1
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 5F. MATRICES FOR MACHINE LEARNING
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  X_tr_ml <- t(
    logCPM_tr[
      genes_ml_fold,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  )


  X_te_ml <- t(
    logCPM_te[
      genes_ml_fold,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  )


  stopifnot(
    identical(
      colnames(X_tr_ml),
      colnames(X_te_ml)
    )
  )


  stopifnot(
    nrow(X_tr_ml) ==
      length(Y_tr)
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 5G. INNER ELASTIC NET
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  set.seed(
    1000 + i
  )


  cvfit_inner <- cv.glmnet(
    x = as.matrix(X_tr_ml),
    y = Y_tr,
    family = "binomial",
    alpha = 0.5,
    nfolds = 3,
    type.measure = "deviance",
    standardize = TRUE
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 5H. OUT-OF-FOLD PREDICTION
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  all_preds_transport[
    test_idx
  ] <- as.numeric(
    predict(
      cvfit_inner,
      newx = as.matrix(
        X_te_ml
      ),
      s = "lambda.1se",
      type = "response"
    )
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 5I. SAVE NONZERO COEFFICIENTS
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  coef_fold <- as.matrix(
    coef(
      cvfit_inner,
      s = "lambda.1se"
    )
  )


  coef_df <- data.frame(
    Fold = paste0(
      "Fold_",
      i
    ),
    Gene = rownames(
      coef_fold
    ),
    Beta = coef_fold[
      ,
      1
    ],
    row.names = NULL,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    filter(
      Gene != "(Intercept)",
      Beta != 0
    )


  genes_history_transport <- bind_rows(
    genes_history_transport,
    coef_df
  )


  cat(
    "Genes EN beta != 0:",
    nrow(coef_df),
    "\n"
  )

}


# ============================================================
# 6. OOF QUALITY CONTROL
# ============================================================

if (anyNA(all_preds_transport)) {
  stop("ERROR: Some PBMC samples lack OOF predictions.")
}


cat("\nPlan B used in:")
cat(
  sum(used_planB_transport),
  "of",
  length(folds),
  "folds\n"
)


# ============================================================
# 7. TRANSPORTABLE MODEL OOF ROC
# ============================================================

roc_transport_oof <- pROC::roc(
  response = y_bin,
  predictor = all_preds_transport,
  levels = c(
    0,
    1
  ),
  direction = "<",
  quiet = TRUE
)


auc_transport_oof <- as.numeric(
  pROC::auc(
    roc_transport_oof
  )
)


ci_transport_oof <- pROC::ci.auc(
  roc_transport_oof
)


cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("INTERNAL CV - TRANSPORTABLE PIPELINE\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

cat(
  "Samples:",
  length(y_bin),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "AUC OOF:",
  round(
    auc_transport_oof,
    3
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "95% CI:",
  round(
    ci_transport_oof[1],
    3
  ),
  "-",
  round(
    ci_transport_oof[3],
    3
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat("============================================================\n")


# Plot the OOF ROC curve

plot(
  roc_transport_oof,
  legacy.axes = TRUE,
  lwd = 3,
  main = paste0(
    "Internal OOF Transportable Model\nAUC = ",
    round(
      auc_transport_oof,
      3
    )
  )
)

abline(
  a = 0,
  b = 1,
  lty = 2,
  col = "gray"
)


# ============================================================
# 8. GENE SELECTION STABILITY ACROSS CV FOLDS
# ============================================================

if (nrow(genes_history_transport) > 0) {

  stability_transport <- genes_history_transport %>%
    group_by(
      Gene
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      Folds_Selected = n_distinct(
        Fold
      ),
      Mean_Beta = mean(
        Beta
      ),
      Median_Beta = median(
        Beta
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Stability_pct =
        100 *
        Folds_Selected /
        length(folds)
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(
        Folds_Selected
      ),
      desc(
        abs(Mean_Beta)
      )
    )

} else {

  stability_transport <- data.frame()

}


cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("TRANSPORTABLE GENE STABILITY\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

print(
  stability_transport
)


write.table(
  stability_transport,
  file =
    "ElasticNet_transportable_gene_stability.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ============================================================
# 9. FINAL TRAINING ON THE ENTIRE PBMC COHORT
# ============================================================

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("FINAL TRANSPORTABLE MODEL TRAINING\n")
cat("============================================================\n")


dds_final <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(
    mat_raw
  ),
  colData = col_data_train,
  design = ~ condition
)


keep_final <- rowSums(
  counts(
    dds_final
  ) >= 10
) >= 5


dds_final <- dds_final[
  keep_final,
]


dds_final <- DESeq(
  dds_final,
  quiet = TRUE
)


res_final <- results(
  dds_final,
  contrast = c(
    "condition",
    "HESN",
    "HIV"
  )
)


res_final_df <- as.data.frame(
  res_final
) %>%
  rownames_to_column(
    "gene"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(padj)
  )


# ============================================================
# 10. FINAL BIOLOGICAL FEATURE SELECTION
# ============================================================

genes_final_input <- res_final_df %>%
  filter(
    padj < 0.05,
    abs(log2FoldChange) > 0.5
  ) %>%
  pull(
    gene
  )


# Plan B

if (length(genes_final_input) < 5) {

  cat(
    "Plan B activated for the final model.\n"
  )

  genes_final_input <- res_final_df %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(pvalue)
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      pvalue
    ) %>%
    slice_head(
      n = 100
    ) %>%
    pull(
      gene
    )
}


cat(
  "Candidate DE genes before transportability restriction:",
  length(genes_final_input),
  "\n"
)


# ============================================================
# 11. RESTRICT TO THE GSE165132 GENE UNIVERSE
# ============================================================

genes_final_input <- intersect(
  genes_final_input,
  genes_externos
)


genes_final_input <- intersect(
  genes_final_input,
  rownames(mat_raw)
)


cat(
  "Transportable genes entering the final Elastic Net:",
  length(genes_final_input),
  "\n"
)


if (length(genes_final_input) < 2) {

  stop(
    "ERROR: Too few genes available for the final model."
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 12. FINAL TMM + logCPM
# ============================================================

base_genes_final <- rownames(
  dds_final
)


dge_final <- DGEList(
  counts = mat_raw[
    base_genes_final,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)


dge_final <- calcNormFactors(
  dge_final,
  method = "TMM"
)


logCPM_final <- cpm(
  dge_final,
  log = TRUE,
  prior.count = 1
)


X_final_transport <- t(
  logCPM_final[
    genes_final_input,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)


# ============================================================
# 13. FINAL TRANSPORTABLE ELASTIC NET
# ============================================================

set.seed(2026)


cv_final_transport <- cv.glmnet(
  x = as.matrix(
    X_final_transport
  ),
  y = y_bin,
  family = "binomial",
  alpha = 0.5,
  nfolds = 5,
  type.measure = "deviance",
  standardize = TRUE
)


lambda_final_transport <-
  cv_final_transport$lambda.1se


coef_final_transport <- as.matrix(
  coef(
    cv_final_transport,
    s = lambda_final_transport
  )
)


firma_final_transport <- data.frame(
  Gene = rownames(
    coef_final_transport
  ),
  Beta = coef_final_transport[
    ,
    1
  ],
  row.names = NULL,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(
    Gene != "(Intercept)",
    Beta != 0
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(
      abs(Beta)
    )
  )


cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("FINAL TRANSPORTABLE SIGNATURE\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

print(
  firma_final_transport
)


cat(
  "\nNumber of genes with nonzero coefficients:",
  nrow(
    firma_final_transport
  ),
  "\n"
)


# ============================================================
# 14. FREEZE THE MODEL
#
# Important:
# genes_input contains ALL columns used to fit
# glmnet, not only genes with nonzero coefficients.
# ============================================================

transport_bundle <- list(

  model =
    cv_final_transport,

  lambda =
    lambda_final_transport,

  genes_input =
    colnames(
      X_final_transport
    ),

  signature_nonzero =
    firma_final_transport,

  positive_class =
    "HESN",

  negative_class =
    "HIV",

  preprocessing =
    "TMM normalization + logCPM prior.count=1",

  alpha =
    0.5,

  training_dataset =
    "PBMC",

  external_dataset =
    "GSE165132"
)


saveRDS(
  transport_bundle,
  file =
    "ElasticNet_transportable_GSE165132_FROZEN.rds"
)


write.table(
  firma_final_transport,
  file =
    "ElasticNet_transportable_signature.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)


cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("MODEL FROZEN\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

cat(
  "Do not modify genes, alpha, lambda, or filters",
  "based on external results.\n"
)


# ============================================================
# 15. NOW LOAD EXTERNAL METADATA
# ============================================================

metadata_ext <- read.csv(
  external_metadata_file,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)


external_expr <- read.csv(
  external_expression_file,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)


colnames(metadata_ext) <-
  trimws(
    colnames(metadata_ext)
  )


colnames(external_expr) <-
  trimws(
    colnames(external_expr)
  )


# ============================================================
# 16. PREPARE EXTERNAL METADATA
# ============================================================

if (!all(
  c(
    "group",
    "subjectID"
  ) %in%
    colnames(metadata_ext)
)) {

  stop(
    "ERROR: External metadata must contain 'group' and 'subjectID'."
  )
}


col_data_ext <- metadata_ext %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(group),
    group != "",
    !is.na(subjectID),
    subjectID != ""
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    condition = factor(
      group,
      levels = c(
        "HIV",
        "HESN"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    subjectID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames(
    var = "subjectID"
  )


cat("\nExternal class distribution:\n")
print(
  table(
    col_data_ext$condition,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 17. PREPARE THE EXTERNAL EXPRESSION MATRIX
# ============================================================

if (!"symbol" %in% colnames(external_expr)) {

  stop(
    "ERROR: External expression data do not contain the 'symbol' column."
  )
}


samples_common <- intersect(
  rownames(
    col_data_ext
  ),
  colnames(
    external_expr
  )
)


cat(
  "External samples shared by metadata and expression:",
  length(samples_common),
  "\n"
)


if (length(samples_common) == 0) {

  stop(
    "ERROR: Sample IDs do not match between external metadata and expression."
  )
}


# Check for duplicated gene symbols

dup_symbols <- external_expr$symbol[
  duplicated(
    external_expr$symbol
  )
]


cat(
  "Duplicated gene symbols in GSE165132:",
  length(
    unique(
      dup_symbols
    )
  ),
  "\n"
)


# Preserve the current behavior:
# retain the first occurrence of each symbol

X_ext <- external_expr %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(symbol),
    symbol != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    symbol,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  select(
    symbol,
    all_of(
      samples_common
    )
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames(
    var = "symbol"
  ) %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  t()


col_data_ext <- col_data_ext[
  rownames(
    X_ext
  ),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]


stopifnot(
  identical(
    rownames(X_ext),
    rownames(col_data_ext)
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 18. TRANSPORTABLE MODEL INTEGRITY CHECK
# ============================================================

missing_final <- setdiff(
  transport_bundle$genes_input,
  colnames(
    X_ext
  )
)


if (length(missing_final) > 0) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "ERROR: The transportable model still requires ",
      "genes missing from GSE165132: ",
      paste(
        missing_final,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}


cat(
  "\nAll genes required by the transportable model",
  "are present in the external dataset.\n"
)


# EXACT column order

X_ext_eval <- X_ext[
  ,
  transport_bundle$genes_input,
  drop = FALSE
]


stopifnot(
  identical(
    colnames(X_ext_eval),
    transport_bundle$genes_input
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 19. CHECK NUMERIC VALUES
# ============================================================

storage.mode(
  X_ext_eval
) <- "double"


if (anyNA(X_ext_eval)) {

  stop(
    "ERROR: Missing values detected in required external genes."
  )
}


if (any(
  !is.finite(
    X_ext_eval
  )
)) {

  stop(
    "ERROR: Non-finite values detected in the external matrix."
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 20. EXTERNAL PREDICTION
# ============================================================

prob_external <- as.numeric(
  predict(
    transport_bundle$model,
    newx = as.matrix(
      X_ext_eval
    ),
    s =
      transport_bundle$lambda,
    type =
      "response"
  )
)


# external outcome:
# HIV = 0
# HESN = 1

y_external <- ifelse(
  col_data_ext$condition ==
    transport_bundle$positive_class,
  1,
  0
)


# ============================================================
# 21. EXTERNAL ROC
# ============================================================

roc_external <- pROC::roc(
  response =
    y_external,
  predictor =
    prob_external,
  levels = c(
    0,
    1
  ),
  direction =
    "<",
  quiet =
    TRUE
)


auc_external <- as.numeric(
  pROC::auc(
    roc_external
  )
)


ci_external <- pROC::ci.auc(
  roc_external
)


cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("EXTERNAL VALIDATION - FROZEN TRANSPORTABLE MODEL\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

cat(
  "Number of external samples:",
  length(
    y_external
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Candidate genes used as glmnet inputs:",
  length(
    transport_bundle$genes_input
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Genes with nonzero final coefficients:",
  nrow(
    firma_final_transport
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "External AUC:",
  round(
    auc_external,
    3
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "95% AUC CI:",
  round(
    ci_external[1],
    3
  ),
  "-",
  round(
    ci_external[3],
    3
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat("============================================================\n")


# ============================================================
# 22. EXTERNAL ROC FIGURE
# ============================================================

plot(
  roc_external,
  legacy.axes = TRUE,
  lwd = 3,
  main = paste0(
    "External validation - GSE165132\n",
    "AUC = ",
    round(
      auc_external,
      3
    ),
    " (95% CI ",
    round(
      ci_external[1],
      3
    ),
    "-",
    round(
      ci_external[3],
      3
    ),
    ")"
  )
)


abline(
  a = 0,
  b = 1,
  lty = 2,
  col = "gray"
)


# ============================================================
# 23. EXPORT EXTERNAL PREDICTIONS
# ============================================================

external_predictions <- data.frame(

  Sample =
    rownames(
      col_data_ext
    ),

  Condition =
    as.character(
      col_data_ext$condition
    ),

  Probability_HESN =
    prob_external,

  stringsAsFactors =
    FALSE
)


write.table(
  external_predictions,
  file =
    "GSE165132_external_predictions_transportable.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ============================================================
# 24. FINAL SUMMARY
# ============================================================

cat("\n\n############################################################\n")
cat("FINAL SUMMARY\n")
cat("############################################################\n")

cat(
  "Transportable pipeline OOF AUC:",
  round(
    auc_transport_oof,
    3
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "OOF 95% CI:",
  round(
    ci_transport_oof[1],
    3
  ),
  "-",
  round(
    ci_transport_oof[3],
    3
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Final signature genes with nonzero coefficients:",
  nrow(
    firma_final_transport
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "External GSE165132 AUC:",
  round(
    auc_external,
    3
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "External 95% CI:",
  round(
    ci_external[1],
    3
  ),
  "-",
  round(
    ci_external[3],
    3
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat("############################################################\n")
```


```{r}
################################################################################
## TRANSPORTABLE ELASTIC NET MODEL FOR GSE165132
##
## Reproduces the original final pipeline:
##
## PBMC (104)
##   -> technical filtering
##   -> TMM + logCPM
##   -> restriction to genes available in GSE165132
##   -> Bootstrap Elastic Net B = 500
##   -> stability >= 40%
##   -> Elastic Net final
##   -> model freezing
##   -> external evaluation on GSE165132
##
## IMPORTANT:
## - Training uses PBMC samples exclusively.
## - Before model freezing, the external dataset provides only gene availability.
## - GSE165132 HIV/HESN labels are read ONLY AFTER model freezing.
################################################################################


# ==============================================================================
# 0. LIBRARIES
# ==============================================================================

library(DESeq2)
library(edgeR)
library(glmnet)
library(pROC)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(parallel)
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)


# ==============================================================================
# 1. INPUT FILES
# ==============================================================================

external_expression_file <-
  "GSE165132_CPM_TMM_log2_gene_counts_matrix.csv"

external_metadata_file <-
  "GSE165132_metadata.csv"


stopifnot(
  file.exists(external_expression_file),
  file.exists(external_metadata_file)
)

cat("Archivos externos encontrados correctamente.\n")


# ==============================================================================
# 2. RETRIEVE THE ORIGINAL PBMC COHORT FROM dds
#
# Avoid using an object named col_data because it was previously
# overwritten by external metadata.
# ==============================================================================

if (!exists("dds")) {
  stop("ERROR: The original PBMC 'dds' object is not loaded.")
}


counts_raw <- counts(dds)

col_data_train <- as.data.frame(
  colData(dds)
)


cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("PBMC TRAINING COHORT\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

cat("Count matrix samples:", ncol(counts_raw), "\n")
cat("Metadata samples:", nrow(col_data_train), "\n")


if (!setequal(
  colnames(counts_raw),
  rownames(col_data_train)
)) {
  stop("ERROR: PBMC counts and metadata do not contain the same samples.")
}


# Reorder metadata to match the count matrix exactly

col_data_train <- col_data_train[
  colnames(counts_raw),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]


stopifnot(
  identical(
    colnames(counts_raw),
    rownames(col_data_train)
  )
)


if (!"condition" %in% colnames(col_data_train)) {
  stop("ERROR: The 'condition' column is missing from colData(dds).")
}


y <- ifelse(
  col_data_train$condition == "HESN",
  1,
  0
)

y <- unname(y)


stopifnot(
  length(y) == ncol(counts_raw),
  length(unique(y)) == 2
)


cat("OK: PBMC samples correctly aligned.\n")

cat("\nClass distribution:\n")
print(
  table(
    factor(
      col_data_train$condition,
      levels = c("HIV", "HESN")
    )
  )
)


# ==============================================================================
# 3. DEFINE THE GSE165132 TECHNICAL GENE UNIVERSE
#
# ONLY THE 'symbol' COLUMN IS USED.
# External metadata are NOT loaded at this stage.
# ==============================================================================

external_gene_table <- read.csv(
  external_expression_file,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)


colnames(external_gene_table) <-
  trimws(colnames(external_gene_table))


if (!"symbol" %in% colnames(external_gene_table)) {
  stop("ERROR: The external file does not contain a 'symbol' column.")
}


genes_external <- trimws(
  as.character(
    external_gene_table$symbol
  )
)


genes_external <- unique(
  genes_external[
    !is.na(genes_external) &
      genes_external != ""
  ]
)


cat("\nUnique genes available in GSE165132:",
    length(genes_external), "\n")


# The complete file no longer needs to be kept in memory

rm(external_gene_table)
gc()


# ==============================================================================
# 4. ORIGINAL TECHNICAL FILTERING IN PBMC
#
# Exactly the criterion used in the original bootstrap:
#     counts >= 10 in at least 15 samples
# ==============================================================================

keep_counts <- rowSums(
  counts_raw >= 10
) >= 15


counts_filtered <- counts_raw[
  keep_counts,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]


cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("PBMC TECHNICAL FILTER\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

cat("Genes before filtering:", nrow(counts_raw), "\n")
cat("Genes after filtering:", nrow(counts_filtered), "\n")


# ==============================================================================
# 5. ORIGINAL NORMALIZATION: TMM + logCPM
#
# IMPORTANT:
# Normalize across all PBMC genes passing the technical filter.
# Predictor features are THEN restricted to genes available
# in the external dataset.
#
# Thus, the external gene restriction does not affect TMM normalization factors.
# ==============================================================================

dge_global <- DGEList(
  counts = counts_filtered
)


dge_global <- calcNormFactors(
  dge_global,
  method = "TMM"
)


X_global_full <- t(
  cpm(
    dge_global,
    log = TRUE,
    prior.count = 1
  )
)


stopifnot(
  identical(
    rownames(X_global_full),
    colnames(counts_filtered)
  )
)


cat("\nComplete normalized PBMC matrix:",
    nrow(X_global_full), "muestras x",
    ncol(X_global_full), "genes\n")


# ==============================================================================
# 6. TRANSPORTABILITY RESTRICTION
#
# This is the only essential modification relative to the original bootstrap.
#
# External HIV/HESN labels are not used.
# Genes are required only to be measurable in GSE165132.
# ==============================================================================

genes_transportables <- intersect(
  colnames(X_global_full),
  genes_external
)


X_transport <- X_global_full[
  ,
  genes_transportables,
  drop = FALSE
]


cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("TRANSPORTABLE GENE UNIVERSE\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

cat("PBMC genes after technical filtering:",
    ncol(X_global_full), "\n")

cat("Genes also present in GSE165132:",
    ncol(X_transport), "\n")

cat("PBMC genes excluded due to external unavailability:",
    ncol(X_global_full) - ncol(X_transport), "\n")


if (ncol(X_transport) < 100) {
  stop("ERROR: The transportable gene universe appears unusually small.")
}


if (anyNA(X_transport)) {
  stop("ERROR: X_transport contiene NA.")
}

if (!all(is.finite(X_transport))) {
  stop("ERROR: X_transport contains non-finite values.")
}


# ==============================================================================
# 7. ELASTIC NET BOOTSTRAP
#
# Original settings:
# B = 500
# alpha = 0.5
# nfolds = 3
# lambda.1se
# deviance
# standardize = TRUE
# ==============================================================================

B <- 500

n <- nrow(X_transport)


num_cores <- max(
  1,
  parallel::detectCores() - 2
)


cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("TRANSPORTABLE BOOTSTRAP\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

cat("Replicates:", B, "\n")
cat("Samples:", n, "\n")
cat("Candidate genes:", ncol(X_transport), "\n")
cat("CPU cores used:", num_cores, "\n")


cl <- makeCluster(
  num_cores
)

registerDoParallel(
  cl
)


clusterExport(
  cl,
  varlist = c(
    "X_transport",
    "y",
    "n"
  ),
  envir = environment()
)


message(
  "Starting ",
  B,
  " bootstrap replicates..."
)


boot_list_transport <- foreach(
  b = 1:B,
  .packages = c("glmnet"),
  .errorhandling = "pass"
) %dopar% {

  # same random-seed strategy as in the original bootstrap
  set.seed(888 + b)


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Sampling with replacement
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  idx <- sample(
    seq_len(n),
    size = n,
    replace = TRUE
  )


  Xb <- X_transport[
    idx,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  yb <- y[
    idx
  ]


  if (length(unique(yb)) < 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Elastic Net
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  cv_b <- cv.glmnet(
    x = Xb,
    y = yb,
    family = "binomial",
    alpha = 0.5,
    nfolds = 3,
    type.measure = "deviance",
    standardize = TRUE
  )


  co <- as.matrix(
    coef(
      cv_b,
      s = "lambda.1se"
    )
  )


  data.frame(
    Gene = rownames(co),
    Beta = as.numeric(co[, 1]),
    Replica = b,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}


stopCluster(
  cl
)


registerDoSEQ()


message(
  "Bootstrap completed."
)


# ==============================================================================
# 8. SUMMARIZE BOOTSTRAP RESULTS
# ==============================================================================

boot_validos_transport <- boot_list_transport[
  sapply(
    boot_list_transport,
    function(x) is.data.frame(x)
  )
]


B_efectivo <- length(
  boot_validos_transport
)


cat("\nSuccessful bootstrap replicates:",
    B_efectivo, "de", B, "\n")


if (B_efectivo < 0.95 * B) {
  warning(
    "Fewer than 95% of bootstrap replicates were valid."
  )
}


boot_flat_transport <- bind_rows(
  boot_validos_transport
)


boot_summary_transport <- boot_flat_transport %>%
  filter(
    Gene != "(Intercept)"
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Gene
  ) %>%
  summarise(

    Frecuencia_Seleccion =
      sum(Beta != 0),

    Porcentaje_Estabilidad =
      100 *
      Frecuencia_Seleccion /
      B_efectivo,

    Mean_Beta_Conditional =
      ifelse(
        Frecuencia_Seleccion > 0,
        mean(
          Beta[
            Beta != 0
          ]
        ),
        NA_real_
      ),

    Median_Beta_Conditional =
      ifelse(
        Frecuencia_Seleccion > 0,
        median(
          Beta[
            Beta != 0
          ]
        ),
        NA_real_
      ),

    SD_Beta_Conditional =
      ifelse(
        Frecuencia_Seleccion > 1,
        sd(
          Beta[
            Beta != 0
          ]
        ),
        NA_real_
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    Clinical_Sign = case_when(

      coalesce(
        Mean_Beta_Conditional,
        0
      ) > 0 ~
        "Higher score in HESN",

      coalesce(
        Mean_Beta_Conditional,
        0
      ) < 0 ~
        "Higher score in HIV",

      TRUE ~
        "Not selected"
    )
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    desc(
      Porcentaje_Estabilidad
    ),
    desc(
      abs(
        coalesce(
          Median_Beta_Conditional,
          0
        )
      )
    )
  )


cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("TOP 30 GENES - TRANSPORTABLE BOOTSTRAP\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

print(
  as.data.frame(
    head(
      boot_summary_transport,
      30
    )
  )
)


write.table(
  boot_summary_transport,
  file =
    "Bootstrap_Transportable_GSE165132_500rep.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)


# Also save the complete object for reproducibility

saveRDS(
  boot_list_transport,
  file =
    "Bootstrap_Transportable_GSE165132_500rep_FULL.rds"
)


# ==============================================================================
# 9. SELECT STABLE BIOMARKERS
#
# Exactly the original stability threshold = 40%
# ==============================================================================

UMBRAL_ESTABILIDAD <- 40


biomarcadores_estables_transport <- boot_summary_transport %>%

  filter(
    !is.na(Gene),
    Gene != "",
    !is.na(Porcentaje_Estabilidad),
    Porcentaje_Estabilidad >=
      UMBRAL_ESTABILIDAD
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    desc(
      Porcentaje_Estabilidad
    )
  ) %>%

  pull(
    Gene
  ) %>%

  unique()


cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("STABLE TRANSPORTABLE BIOMARKERS\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

cat("Threshold:", UMBRAL_ESTABILIDAD, "%\n")

cat(
  "Genes >= 40%:",
  length(
    biomarcadores_estables_transport
  ),
  "\n"
)


if (length(
  biomarcadores_estables_transport
) < 3) {

  stop(
    "ERROR: Fewer than 3 genes reach stability >=40%."
  )
}


# ==============================================================================
# 10. FINAL MODEL INPUT MATRIX
# ==============================================================================

genes_finales_transport <- biomarcadores_estables_transport[
  biomarcadores_estables_transport %in%
    colnames(X_transport)
]


X_final_transport <- X_transport[
  ,
  genes_finales_transport,
  drop = FALSE
]


y_factor_train <- factor(
  col_data_train$condition,
  levels = c(
    "HIV",
    "HESN"
  )
)


y_final <- ifelse(
  y_factor_train == "HESN",
  1,
  0
)

y_final <- unname(
  as.numeric(
    y_final
  )
)


stopifnot(
  nrow(X_final_transport) ==
    length(y_final)
)

stopifnot(
  identical(
    rownames(X_final_transport),
    rownames(col_data_train)
  )
)


cat("\nX_final_transport dimensions:\n")
print(
  dim(
    X_final_transport
  )
)


# ==============================================================================
# 11. FINAL ELASTIC NET
#
# Reproduces the original exportable model settings:
# set.seed(42)
# alpha = 0.5
# nfolds = 5
# lambda.1se
# keep = TRUE
# ==============================================================================

set.seed(42)


cv_final_transport <- cv.glmnet(

  x = X_final_transport,

  y = y_final,

  family = "binomial",

  alpha = 0.5,

  nfolds = 5,

  type.measure = "deviance",

  standardize = TRUE,

  keep = TRUE
)


lambda_final_transport <-
  cv_final_transport$lambda.1se


cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("FINAL TRANSPORTABLE ELASTIC NET\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

cat(
  "Lambda.min:",
  cv_final_transport$lambda.min,
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Lambda.1se:",
  lambda_final_transport,
  "\n"
)


# ==============================================================================
# 12. EXTRACT FINAL ACTIVE SIGNATURE
# ==============================================================================

coef_final_transport <- as.matrix(
  coef(
    cv_final_transport,
    s = "lambda.1se"
  )
)


df_coef_transport <- data.frame(

  Gene =
    rownames(
      coef_final_transport
    ),

  Beta_Final =
    as.numeric(
      coef_final_transport[
        ,
        1
      ]
    ),

  stringsAsFactors =
    FALSE
) %>%

  left_join(
    boot_summary_transport,
    by = "Gene"
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    Seleccionado_Modelo_Final =
      Gene == "(Intercept)" |
      Beta_Final != 0,

    Direccion = case_when(

      Gene == "(Intercept)" ~
        "Intercept",

      Beta_Final > 0 ~
        "Higher score toward HESN",

      Beta_Final < 0 ~
        "Higher score toward HIV",

      TRUE ~
        "Zero coefficient"
    )
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    desc(
      abs(
        Beta_Final
      )
    )
  )


firma_transportable_final <- df_coef_transport %>%

  filter(
    Gene != "(Intercept)",
    Beta_Final != 0
  )


cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("FINAL TRANSPORTABLE SIGNATURE\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

cat(
  "Candidate genes from bootstrap:",
  length(
    genes_finales_transport
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Active genes with beta != 0:",
  nrow(
    firma_transportable_final
  ),
  "\n\n"
)


print(
  firma_transportable_final
)


write.table(
  df_coef_transport,
  file =
    "ElasticNet_Transportable_Coeficientes_Completos.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)


write.table(
  firma_transportable_final,
  file =
    "ElasticNet_Transportable_Genes_Activos.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ==============================================================================
# 13. APPARENT AUC OF THE FINAL MODEL
#
# Descriptive ONLY.
# Does NOT replace out-of-fold AUC.
# ==============================================================================

prob_aparente_transport <- as.numeric(

  predict(

    cv_final_transport,

    newx =
      X_final_transport,

    s =
      "lambda.1se",

    type =
      "response"
  )
)


roc_aparente_transport <- pROC::roc(

  response =
    y_final,

  predictor =
    prob_aparente_transport,

  levels =
    c(0, 1),

  direction =
    "<",

  quiet =
    TRUE
)


auc_aparente_transport <- as.numeric(
  pROC::auc(
    roc_aparente_transport
  )
)


ci_aparente_transport <- pROC::ci.auc(
  roc_aparente_transport
)


cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("APPARENT AUC - DESCRIPTIVE ONLY\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

cat(
  "AUC:",
  round(
    auc_aparente_transport,
    3
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "IC95%:",
  round(
    ci_aparente_transport[1],
    3
  ),
  "-",
  round(
    ci_aparente_transport[3],
    3
  ),
  "\n"
)


# ==============================================================================
# 14. FREEZE THE MODEL
#
# FROM THIS POINT ON:
# do not modify genes, cutoff, alpha, or lambda based on GSE165132.
# ==============================================================================

model_bundle_transport <- list(

  model =
    cv_final_transport,

  genes_input =
    genes_finales_transport,

  genes_active =
    firma_transportable_final$Gene,

  coefficients =
    df_coef_transport,

  bootstrap_summary =
    boot_summary_transport,

  bootstrap_B =
    B,

  bootstrap_B_effective =
    B_efectivo,

  stability_cutoff =
    UMBRAL_ESTABILIDAD,

  alpha =
    0.5,

  lambda =
    lambda_final_transport,

  lambda_rule =
    "lambda.1se",

  positive_class =
    "HESN",

  negative_class =
    "HIV",

  preprocessing = list(

    training =
      "PBMC raw counts -> filter counts>=10 in >=15 samples -> TMM -> logCPM prior.count=1",

    feature_transportability =
      "Classifier feature universe restricted to genes present in GSE165132 before bootstrap",

    glmnet_standardize =
      TRUE
  ),

  training = list(

    n_samples =
      nrow(
        X_final_transport
      ),

    class_distribution =
      table(
        y_factor_train
      ),

    random_seed_final =
      42
  )
)


saveRDS(
  model_bundle_transport,
  file =
    "Clasificador_Transportable_GSE165132_FROZEN.rds"
)


cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("MODELO CONGELADO\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

cat(
  "External phenotypes may now be read.\n"
)


# ==============================================================================
# 15. NOW LOAD THE COMPLETE EXTERNAL DATASET
# ==============================================================================

external_expr <- read.csv(
  external_expression_file,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)


metadata_ext <- read.csv(
  external_metadata_file,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)


colnames(external_expr) <-
  trimws(
    colnames(external_expr)
  )


colnames(metadata_ext) <-
  trimws(
    colnames(metadata_ext)
  )


# ==============================================================================
# 16. PREPARE EXTERNAL METADATA
# ==============================================================================

if (!all(
  c(
    "subjectID",
    "group"
  ) %in%
    colnames(metadata_ext)
)) {

  stop(
    "ERROR: external metadata must contain 'subjectID' y 'group'."
  )
}


col_data_ext <- metadata_ext %>%

  filter(
    !is.na(subjectID),
    subjectID != "",
    !is.na(group),
    group != ""
  ) %>%

  distinct(
    subjectID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    condition =
      factor(
        group,
        levels = c(
          "HIV",
          "HESN"
        )
      )
  ) %>%

  column_to_rownames(
    "subjectID"
  )


if (anyNA(
  col_data_ext$condition
)) {

  stop(
    "ERROR: External group values other than HIV/HESN were detected."
  )
}


cat("\nExternal phenotype distribution:\n")

print(
  table(
    col_data_ext$condition
  )
)


# ==============================================================================
# 17. CHECK FOR DUPLICATED GENE SYMBOLS
# ==============================================================================

external_expr$symbol <-
  trimws(
    as.character(
      external_expr$symbol
    )
  )


dup_genes <- unique(
  external_expr$symbol[
    duplicated(
      external_expr$symbol
    ) |
      duplicated(
        external_expr$symbol,
        fromLast = TRUE
      )
  ]
)


dup_genes <- dup_genes[
  !is.na(dup_genes) &
    dup_genes != ""
]


cat(
  "\nDuplicated genes in external dataset:",
  length(
    dup_genes
  ),
  "\n"
)


if (length(dup_genes) > 0) {

  cat(
    "Duplicates:",
    paste(
      dup_genes,
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    "\n"
  )
}


# Check whether any duplicated genes are required by the model

dup_required <- intersect(
  dup_genes,
  model_bundle_transport$genes_input
)


if (length(
  dup_required
) > 0) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "WARNING: Some model-required genes are duplicated in ",
      "GSE165132: ",
      paste(
        dup_required,
        collapse = ", "
      ),
      ". Review before proceeding."
    )
  )
}


# If a duplicated gene is NOT required by the model, we can retain
# the first occurrence without affecting the required features.

external_expr_unique <- external_expr %>%

  filter(
    !is.na(symbol),
    symbol != ""
  ) %>%

  distinct(
    symbol,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )


# ==============================================================================
# 18. IDENTIFY MATCHING EXTERNAL SAMPLES
# ==============================================================================

samples_common <- intersect(

  rownames(
    col_data_ext
  ),

  colnames(
    external_expr_unique
  )
)


cat(
  "\nUsable external samples:",
  length(
    samples_common
  ),
  "\n"
)


if (length(
  samples_common
) == 0) {

  stop(
    "ERROR: No sample IDs match between external metadata and expression data."
  )
}


# ==============================================================================
# 19. EXTERNAL EXPRESSION MATRIX
# ==============================================================================

X_ext <- external_expr_unique %>%

  select(
    symbol,
    all_of(
      samples_common
    )
  ) %>%

  column_to_rownames(
    "symbol"
  ) %>%

  as.matrix() %>%

  t()


storage.mode(
  X_ext
) <- "double"


col_data_ext <- col_data_ext[
  rownames(
    X_ext
  ),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]


stopifnot(
  identical(
    rownames(X_ext),
    rownames(col_data_ext)
  )
)


# ==============================================================================
# 20. VERIFY THAT ALL MODEL GENES ARE AVAILABLE
# ==============================================================================

missing_external <- setdiff(

  model_bundle_transport$genes_input,

  colnames(
    X_ext
  )
)


if (length(
  missing_external
) > 0) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "ERROR: The transportable model requires missing genes: ",
      paste(
        missing_external,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  )
}


cat(
  "\nAll genes required by the frozen model are present in GSE165132.\n"
)


# EXACT training feature order

X_ext_eval <- X_ext[
  ,
  model_bundle_transport$genes_input,
  drop = FALSE
]


stopifnot(
  identical(
    colnames(X_ext_eval),
    model_bundle_transport$genes_input
  )
)


if (anyNA(
  X_ext_eval
)) {

  stop(
    "ERROR: X_ext_eval contains NA values."
  )
}


if (!all(
  is.finite(
    X_ext_eval
  )
)) {

  stop(
    "ERROR: X_ext_eval contains non-finite values."
  )
}


# ==============================================================================
# 21. EXTERNAL PREDICTION
# ==============================================================================

prob_external_transport <- as.numeric(

  predict(

    model_bundle_transport$model,

    newx =
      X_ext_eval,

    s =
      model_bundle_transport$lambda,

    type =
      "response"
  )
)


y_external <- ifelse(

  col_data_ext$condition ==
    model_bundle_transport$positive_class,

  1,

  0
)


# ==============================================================================
# 22. EXTERNAL ROC / AUC
#
# Threshold, accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity are not evaluated here.
# Discrimination/ranking is evaluated using AUC.
# ==============================================================================

roc_external_transport <- pROC::roc(

  response =
    y_external,

  predictor =
    prob_external_transport,

  levels =
    c(
      0,
      1
    ),

  direction =
    "<",

  quiet =
    TRUE
)


auc_external_transport <- as.numeric(

  pROC::auc(
    roc_external_transport
  )
)


ci_external_transport <- pROC::ci.auc(
  roc_external_transport
)


cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("EXTERNAL VALIDATION ON GSE165132\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

cat(
  "External sample size:",
  length(
    y_external
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Stable genes used as INPUT:",
  length(
    model_bundle_transport$genes_input
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Active genes with beta != 0:",
  length(
    model_bundle_transport$genes_active
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "External AUC:",
  round(
    auc_external_transport,
    3
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "IC95%:",
  round(
    ci_external_transport[1],
    3
  ),
  "-",
  round(
    ci_external_transport[3],
    3
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat("============================================================\n")


# ==============================================================================
# 23. EXTERNAL ROC CURVE
# ==============================================================================

plot(
  roc_external_transport,
  legacy.axes = TRUE,
  lwd = 3,
  main = paste0(
    "GSE165132 - Transportable Bootstrap Model\n",
    "AUC = ",
    round(
      auc_external_transport,
      3
    ),
    " (95% CI ",
    round(
      ci_external_transport[1],
      3
    ),
    "-",
    round(
      ci_external_transport[3],
      3
    ),
    ")"
  )
)


abline(
  a = 0,
  b = 1,
  lty = 2
)


# ==============================================================================
# 24. SAVE EXTERNAL PREDICTIONS
# ==============================================================================

external_predictions_transport <- data.frame(

  Sample =
    rownames(
      X_ext_eval
    ),

  Condition =
    as.character(
      col_data_ext$condition
    ),

  Probability_HESN =
    prob_external_transport,

  stringsAsFactors =
    FALSE
)


write.table(
  external_predictions_transport,
  file =
    "GSE165132_Predicciones_Modelo_Transportable_Bootstrap.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ==============================================================================
# 25. COMPARISON WITH THE ORIGINAL 17-GENE SIGNATURE
#
# Descriptive only; does NOT modify the model.
# ==============================================================================

genes_originales_17 <- c(

  "SYNE1",
  "UTRN",
  "C8orf88",
  "STMN1",
  "ZNF804A",
  "CEMIP2",
  "TNNC1",
  "BIRC5",
  "IFI44L",
  "CLEC2L",
  "CD38",
  "PCLAF",
  "GBP1",
  "IFI27",
  "TMEM155",
  "TRBV7-1",
  "SERPING1"
)


overlap_original_transport <- intersect(

  genes_originales_17,

  firma_transportable_final$Gene
)


cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("OVERLAP WITH THE ORIGINAL 17-GENE SIGNATURE\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

cat(
  "Shared genes:",
  length(
    overlap_original_transport
  ),
  "de 17\n"
)

cat(
  paste(
    overlap_original_transport,
    collapse = ", "
  ),
  "\n"
)


# ==============================================================================
# 26. FINAL SUMMARY
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n\n############################################################\n")
cat("FINAL TRANSPORTABILITY SUMMARY\n")
cat("############################################################\n")

cat(
  "Genes in external universe:",
  length(
    genes_external
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "PBMC genes after technical filtering:",
  ncol(
    X_global_full
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Transportable genes evaluated in bootstrap:",
  ncol(
    X_transport
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Valid bootstrap replicates:",
  B_efectivo,

)

cat(
  "Genes with stability >=40%:",

  ),

)

cat(

cat(

    ci_external_transport[3],
    3
  ),

)

cat("############################################################\n")
```

```{r}

################################################################################
## EXPLORATORY OPTIMAL CUTOFF BASED ON THE YOUDEN INDEX
## EXTERNAL COHORT GSE165132
################################################################################

# roc_external_transport has already been computed
# HESN = positive class (1)
# HIV  = negative class (0)

youden_ext <- pROC::coords(
  roc_external_transport,
  x = "best",
  best.method = "youden",
  ret = c(
    "threshold",
    "sensitivity",
    "specificity"
  ),
  transpose = FALSE
)

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("YOUDEN CUTOFF - GSE165132 (EXPLORATORY)\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

print(youden_ext)


# Extract the optimal threshold
threshold_youden_ext <- as.numeric(
  youden_ext["threshold", ]
)

# In some pROC versions, coords() returns a data frame
if (is.data.frame(youden_ext)) {
  threshold_youden_ext <- as.numeric(
    youden_ext$threshold[1]
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Classify samples using the externally derived cutoff
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

pred_external_youden <- ifelse(
  prob_external_transport >= threshold_youden_ext,
  1,
  0
)


# Compute the confusion matrix
cm_ext <- table(
  Predicted = pred_external_youden,
  Observed = y_external
)

cat("\nConfusion matrix:\n")
print(cm_ext)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Calculate classification performance metrics
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

TP <- sum(
  pred_external_youden == 1 &
  y_external == 1
)

TN <- sum(
  pred_external_youden == 0 &
  y_external == 0
)

FP <- sum(
  pred_external_youden == 1 &
  y_external == 0
)

FN <- sum(
  pred_external_youden == 0 &
  y_external == 1
)


sensitivity_ext <- TP / (TP + FN)

specificity_ext <- TN / (TN + FP)

accuracy_ext <- (TP + TN) /
  length(y_external)

ppv_ext <- TP / (TP + FP)

npv_ext <- TN / (TN + FN)

balanced_accuracy_ext <-
  (sensitivity_ext + specificity_ext) / 2

youden_J_ext <-
  sensitivity_ext + specificity_ext - 1


metricas_youden_ext <- data.frame(
  Threshold = threshold_youden_ext,
  Sensitivity = sensitivity_ext,
  Specificity = specificity_ext,
  Balanced_Accuracy = balanced_accuracy_ext,
  Accuracy = accuracy_ext,
  PPV = ppv_ext,
  NPV = npv_ext,
  Youden_J = youden_J_ext
)


cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("CLASSIFICATION METRICS AT THE EXTERNAL YOUDEN CUTOFF\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

print(metricas_youden_ext)


write.table(
  metricas_youden_ext,
  file = "GSE165132_Youden_Exploratorio.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)


# Compute ROC AUC and its 95% confidence interval
auc_ext <- as.numeric(
  pROC::auc(roc_external_transport)
)

ci_auc_ext <- as.numeric(
  pROC::ci.auc(roc_external_transport)
)

# Retrieve all optimal thresholds according to the Youden index
youden_ext <- pROC::coords(
  roc_external_transport,
  x = "best",
  best.method = "youden",
  ret = c(
    "threshold",
    "sensitivity",
    "specificity"
  ),
  transpose = FALSE
)

# Add the Youden index, balanced accuracy, AUC, and 95% confidence interval
resultado_youden <- youden_ext %>%
  mutate(
    Youden_J = sensitivity + specificity - 1,
    Balanced_Accuracy = (sensitivity + specificity) / 2,
    AUC = auc_ext,
    AUC_CI95_Lower = ci_auc_ext[1],
    AUC_CI95_Upper = ci_auc_ext[3]
  )

print(resultado_youden)

```

```{r}

## =============================================================================
## TTS — TRANSPORTABLE OUT-OF-FOLD PIPELINE
## =============================================================================

library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

## Validate OOF predictions and sample counts
stopifnot(
  length(all_preds_transport) == 104,
  !anyNA(all_preds_transport),
  length(all_preds_transport) == ncol(counts(dds))
)


## Verify OOF prediction integrity before survival analysis
if (!exists("all_preds_transport")) stop("ERROR: Transportable OOF predictions are unavailable.")
if (!exists("dds")) stop("ERROR: DESeq2 object is unavailable.")
if (!exists("df_surv")) stop("ERROR: Survival metadata are unavailable.")

sample_ids <- colnames(DESeq2::counts(dds))
stopifnot(length(all_preds_transport) == length(sample_ids))
stopifnot(!anyNA(all_preds_transport))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(sample_ids))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(df_surv$sampleID))
stopifnot(setequal(sample_ids, df_surv$sampleID))

## Positional correspondence must be guaranteed by the prediction pipeline
cat("OOF predictions:", length(all_preds_transport), "\n")
cat("Survival participants:", nrow(df_surv), "\n")


## Match each OOF prediction to its corresponding PBMC sample
df_scores_transport_oof <- data.frame(
  sampleID = colnames(counts(dds)),
  en_score_transport_oof = all_preds_transport
)

## Integrate OOF predictions with survival data
df_surv_transport_oof <- df_surv %>%
  left_join(
    df_scores_transport_oof,
    by = "sampleID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Predictions represent P(HESN); therefore, the score is inverted:
    # higher values indicate greater predicted seroconversion risk
    en_risk_transport_oof = -en_score_transport_oof,

    # Express the hazard ratio per 1-SD increase in the risk score
    en_score_transport_z =
      as.numeric(scale(en_risk_transport_oof))
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(df_surv_transport_oof) == 104,
  !anyDuplicated(df_surv_transport_oof$sampleID),
  !anyNA(df_surv_transport_oof$en_score_transport_oof),
  !anyNA(df_surv_transport_oof$en_score_transport_z)
)

cat(
  "Correlation between risk score and P(HESN):",
  cor(
    df_surv_transport_oof$en_risk_transport_oof,
    df_surv_transport_oof$en_score_transport_oof
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Sample size:",
  nrow(df_surv_transport_oof),
  "\n"
)

```



```{r}

## =============================================================================
## TTS — TRANSPORTABLE OUT-OF-FOLD PIPELINE
## KAPLAN–MEIER + LOG-RANK + TIME-VARYING COX + C-INDEX + HR(t)
## =============================================================================

library(survival)
library(dplyr)

## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 1. TRANSPORTABLE OOF RISK TERTILES
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------

q_transport_oof <- quantile(
  df_surv_transport_oof$en_risk_transport_oof,
  probs = c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

df_surv_transport_oof$Grupo_KM_transport_OOF <- cut(
  df_surv_transport_oof$en_risk_transport_oof,
  breaks = q_transport_oof,
  labels = c("T1_LowRisk", "T2_MedRisk", "T3_HighRisk"),
  include.lowest = TRUE
)

cat("\n=================================================================\n")
cat("--- EVENTS BY TRANSPORTABLE OOF RISK TERTILE ---\n")
cat("=================================================================\n")

print(
  table(
    df_surv_transport_oof$Grupo_KM_transport_OOF,
    df_surv_transport_oof$event
  )
)


## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 2. TRANSPORTABLE OOF KAPLAN–MEIER AND LOG-RANK ANALYSIS
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------

surv_obj_transport_oof <- Surv(
  time  = df_surv_transport_oof$TTS,
  event = df_surv_transport_oof$event
)

logrank_transport_oof <- survdiff(
  surv_obj_transport_oof ~ Grupo_KM_transport_OOF,
  data = df_surv_transport_oof
)

p_logrank_transport_oof <- pchisq(
  logrank_transport_oof$chisq,
  df = length(logrank_transport_oof$n) - 1,
  lower.tail = FALSE
)

cat("\n=================================================================\n")
cat("--- TRANSPORTABLE OOF LOG-RANK TEST ---\n")
cat("=================================================================\n")

print(logrank_transport_oof)

cat(
  "\np =",
  format.pval(
    p_logrank_transport_oof,
    digits = 6,
    eps = 1e-300
  ),
  "\n"
)


## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 3. COMPLETE-CASE DATASET FOR COX REGRESSION
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------

vars_transport <- c(
  "TTS",
  "event",
  "age",
  "risk",
  "en_score_transport_z"
)

df_transport_clean <- df_surv_transport_oof[
  complete.cases(
    df_surv_transport_oof[, vars_transport]
  ),
]

cat(
  "\nSample size for transportable OOF Cox regression:",
  nrow(df_transport_clean),
  "\n"
)


## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 4. BASELINE CLINICAL COX MODEL
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------

cox_clin_transport <- coxph(
  Surv(TTS, event) ~ age + risk,
  data = df_transport_clean
)


## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 5. TIME-VARYING COX MODEL WITH THE TRANSPORTABLE OOF SCORE
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------

cox_tv_transport_oof <- coxph(
  Surv(TTS, event) ~
    en_score_transport_z +
    age +
    risk +
    tt(en_score_transport_z),
  data = df_transport_clean,
  tt = function(x, t, ...) {
    x * log(t + 1)
  }
)

cat("\n=================================================================\n")
cat("--- TIME-VARYING COX MODEL — TRANSPORTABLE OOF SCORE ---\n")
cat("=================================================================\n")

print(summary(cox_tv_transport_oof))


## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 6. LIKELIHOOD RATIO TEST: CLINICAL VS. CLINICAL + TIME-VARYING SCORE
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------

ll_clin_transport <- logLik(
  cox_clin_transport
)

ll_tv_transport <- logLik(
  cox_tv_transport_oof
)

lrt_transport <- 2 * (
  as.numeric(ll_tv_transport) -
    as.numeric(ll_clin_transport)
)

df_lrt_transport <-
  attr(ll_tv_transport, "df") -
  attr(ll_clin_transport, "df")

p_lrt_transport <- pchisq(
  lrt_transport,
  df = df_lrt_transport,
  lower.tail = FALSE
)

cat("\n=================================================================\n")
cat("--- TRANSPORTABLE OOF LIKELIHOOD RATIO TEST ---\n")
cat("=================================================================\n")

cat(
  "Chi-square =",
  round(lrt_transport, 3),
  "| df =",
  df_lrt_transport,
  "| p =",
  format.pval(p_lrt_transport, digits = 6),
  "\n"
)


## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 7. CONCORDANCE INDEX (C-INDEX)
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------

sum_clin_transport <- summary(
  cox_clin_transport
)

sum_tv_transport <- summary(
  cox_tv_transport_oof
)

c_clin_transport <-
  unname(sum_clin_transport$concordance[1])

se_clin_transport <-
  unname(sum_clin_transport$concordance[2])

c_tv_transport <-
  unname(sum_tv_transport$concordance[1])

se_tv_transport <-
  unname(sum_tv_transport$concordance[2])

delta_c_transport <-
  c_tv_transport - c_clin_transport

cat("\n=================================================================\n")
cat("--- TRANSPORTABLE OOF CONCORDANCE INDEX ---\n")
cat("=================================================================\n")

cat(
  sprintf(
    "Clinical model C-index     : %.3f (SE %.3f)\n",
    c_clin_transport,
    se_clin_transport
  )
)

cat(
  sprintf(
    "Clinical + OOF score C-index: %.3f (SE %.3f)\n",
    c_tv_transport,
    se_tv_transport
  )
)

cat(
  sprintf(
    "OOF C-index difference      : +%.3f\n",
    delta_c_transport
  )
)


## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 8. TIME-DEPENDENT HAZARD RATIO: HR(t)
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------

beta_main_transport <-
  coef(cox_tv_transport_oof)[
    "en_score_transport_z"
  ]

beta_tt_transport <-
  coef(cox_tv_transport_oof)[
    "tt(en_score_transport_z)"
  ]

V_transport <- vcov(
  cox_tv_transport_oof
)

times_eval <- c(
  30,
  90,
  180,
  365,
  730,
  1095
)

hr_time_transport <- lapply(
  times_eval,
  function(t) {

    L <- log(t + 1)

    logHR <-
      beta_main_transport +
      beta_tt_transport * L

    var_logHR <-
      V_transport[
        "en_score_transport_z",
        "en_score_transport_z"
      ] +
      (L^2) *
      V_transport[
        "tt(en_score_transport_z)",
        "tt(en_score_transport_z)"
      ] +
      2 * L *
      V_transport[
        "en_score_transport_z",
        "tt(en_score_transport_z)"
      ]

    se_logHR <- sqrt(
      var_logHR
    )

    data.frame(
      Time_days = t,
      HR = exp(logHR),
      Lower_95CI =
        exp(logHR - 1.96 * se_logHR),
      Upper_95CI =
        exp(logHR + 1.96 * se_logHR)
    )
  }
)

hr_time_transport <- bind_rows(
  hr_time_transport
)

cat("\n=================================================================\n")
cat("--- TIME-DEPENDENT HR(t) — TRANSPORTABLE OOF SCORE ---\n")
cat("=================================================================\n")

print(
  hr_time_transport %>%
    mutate(
      HR = round(HR, 3),
      Lower_95CI = round(Lower_95CI, 3),
      Upper_95CI = round(Upper_95CI, 3)
    ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 9. ESTIMATED TIME AT WHICH HR(t) = 1
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------

t_cross_transport <- exp(
  -beta_main_transport /
    beta_tt_transport
) - 1

cat(
  "\nHR(t) is estimated to cross HR = 1 at approximately day:",
  round(t_cross_transport, 1),
  "\n"
)


## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 10. EXPORT RESULTS
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------

write.table(
  hr_time_transport,
  file = "Transportable_Pipeline_OOF_TimeVarying_HR.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nTransportable OOF results successfully exported.\n")

```

```{r}
## =============================================================================

library(survival)

## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 1. PREDICTIONS FROM THE FINAL 14-GENE MODEL

trans14_prob_hesn <- as.numeric(
  predict(
    cv_final_transport,
    newx = X_final_transport,
    s = "lambda.1se",
    type = "response"
  )
)

## Sample IDs must correspond to the rows of X_final_transport
stopifnot(
  length(trans14_prob_hesn) == 104,
  nrow(X_final_transport) == 104,
  !is.null(rownames(X_final_transport))
)

trans14_scores <- data.frame(
  sampleID = rownames(X_final_transport),
  trans14_prob_hesn = trans14_prob_hesn
)

## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 2. INTEGRATION WITH TIME-TO-SEROCONVERSION DATA
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------

trans14_surv <- df_surv %>%
  select(
    sampleID,
    condition,
    TTS,
    event,
    age,
    risk
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    trans14_scores,
    by = "sampleID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Invert P(HESN) so that higher scores indicate higher predicted risk
    trans14_risk = -trans14_prob_hesn,

    # Standardize the risk score for Cox regression
    trans14_risk_z = as.numeric(
      scale(trans14_risk)
    )
  )

## -------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 3. DATA INTEGRITY CHECKS
## -------------------------------------------------------------------------

stopifnot(
  nrow(trans14_surv) == 104,
  !anyDuplicated(trans14_surv$sampleID),
  !anyNA(trans14_surv$trans14_prob_hesn),
  !anyNA(trans14_surv$trans14_risk_z)
)
```
